combos.name: Grooming
combos.definition: Grooming is the sequence where attention, access and apparent specialness are staged to lower someone's guard, test what they will tolerate, and build an attachment later used to steer their decisions, using Love Bombing, Boundary Testing, Manufactured Intimacy, Intermittent Reinforcement, Isolation, Identity Hooking and Conditional Love to convert a young person's need to be seen, wanted and safely attached into the loss of independent judgment. It is hard to detect in music because the attention and the talent can both be real and the generosity arrives before any terms exist. The cost can be money, years, control of a name, and in the worst cases safety, which is why minors route to child-welfare supports and not to negotiation.

combos.name: The Trauma Bond Engine
combos.definition: The Trauma Bond Engine is the sequence where each experience of harm or withdrawal is followed by enough warmth to deepen attachment, using Intermittent Reinforcement, Trauma Bonding, Relief Bait, Push-Pull, FOG, Hoovering and Conditional Love to convert a person's need to make sense of pain by bonding with its source into lost objectivity about the relationship. It is hard to detect because the warmth is real, the history is shared, and the offers are often commercially genuine. In music the stakes are a tour, a catalog and a name. What may be lost is the person's own read on whether the working relationship is safe.

combos.name: The Savior Trap
combos.definition: The Savior Trap is the sequence where a crisis and an appeal to competence are used to draw a skilled person into open-ended unpaid work, using The Rescue Hook, Premature Vulnerability, Emotional Parasitism, Obligation Installation, Guilt-Tripping and Duty Scripts to convert empathy and the desire to help into lost boundaries, time and the guilt-free right to say no. It is hard to detect because the crisis may be real, the gratitude may be sincere and the helper chooses to stay. In studios and on sessions it hides inside normal favors and "just this weekend" requests. What may be lost is unpaid hours, other clients, and the standing to ask for terms.

combos.name: The Compliment Trap
combos.definition: The Compliment Trap is the sequence where elevation and diminishment are alternated so that one person's approval becomes the measure of another's worth, using Pedestal Ploy, Negging, Comparative Devaluation, Intermittent Reinforcement and Conditional Love to convert a writer's need for external validation into a loss of stable self-esteem independent of one gatekeeper's opinion. It is hard to detect in creative work because honest criticism looks like it, praise can be sincere, and the room really is competitive. What may be lost is confidence, credit, and the ability to judge one's own work.

combos.name: Bait and Switch
combos.definition: Bait and Switch is the sequence where what was promised bears little resemblance to what is delivered, but the substitution is staged slowly enough that by the time the gap is visible, leaving costs more than staying, using Catfishing, Future Faking, Moving Goalposts, Commitment Traps and Sunk Cost Exploitation to convert trust in stated representations into money, time and opportunity already committed. In pay-to-play showcases and development programs, the audience, the "selection" and the access promised are the bait, and the fee schedule is the switch. What may be lost is savings, months of an artist's early career, and confidence.

combos.name: Emotional Debt Spiral
combos.definition: The Emotional Debt Spiral is the sequence where every gift becomes a debt, every debt requires gratitude, and unmet expectations generate guilt, using Loan-Sharking Gifts, Favor Debt, Obligation Hooks, Demand for Gratitude, Guilt-Tripping and Obligation Contracts to convert the ordinary human norm of reciprocating kindness into perpetual, invisible obligation. It is hard to detect in music because generosity, free studio time and mentorship are real and valued, and because the first gift usually comes with no strings attached. What may be lost is the ability to receive help without owing something open-ended, and in some cases ownership of work.

combos.name: The Gratitude Prison
combos.definition: The Gratitude Prison is the sequence where continuous thankfulness becomes the price of belonging and any complaint is met with a recital of what has been done, using Loan-Sharking Gifts, Demand for Gratitude, Weaponized Generosity in Public, Guilt Legacy, Obligation Contracts and Punishment of Boundaries to convert an artist's need for belonging and acceptance into the loss of the right to voice complaints without being called ungrateful. It is hard to detect because support from a label or manager is often real and expensive, and because a rest request is easy to describe as a scheduling inconvenience. What may be lost is health, rest, voice, and the standing to say no.

combos.name: The False Safe Harbor
combos.definition: The False Safe Harbor is the sequence where one person or group becomes a performer's only source of comfort and safety, and then uses that dependency to return them to the source of harm, using Love Bombing, Manufactured Intimacy, "We're Family" Erasure, Isolation, FOG and Conditional Love to convert a need for a safe, stable source of comfort into the loss of independent support outside the source of harm. It is hard to detect on tour because companies really can feel like families, because the comfort is real, and because distance from home makes the company the only option. What may be lost is outside relationships, a sense of what is normal, and the ability to leave.

combos.name: Exit Prevention Architecture
combos.definition: The Exit Prevention Architecture is the sequence where an imprint, label or management structure makes departure feel more costly, more dangerous and more disloyal than staying, layering money, housing, fear, confusion and emotional pressure until every door seems to lead somewhere worse. It can use sunk cost exploitation, golden bars, financial enmeshment, financial dependence by design, catastrophizing as control, FOG, phobia indoctrination, hoovering and emotional blackmail via self-harm threats to convert an artist's accumulated investment into the loss of exit options in every domain at once. It is hard to detect because each layer has a benign twin: real generosity, real debt, real fear of a hard industry, real distress. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: The Golden Cage
combos.definition: The Golden Cage is the sequence where generous, real benefits are calibrated to make leaving feel ungrateful and unaffordable, using golden bars, financial enmeshment, financial dependence by design, sunk cost exploitation, performative public affection and conditional love to convert a desire for comfort and security into a willingness to stay in a situation that is materially good but not autonomous. It benefits whoever controls the perks and the renewal. It is hard to detect because the comforts are real and the affection is visible. What the person can lose is the capacity to say no without losing home, health coverage and standing together. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: Golden Handcuffs
combos.definition: Golden Handcuffs is the sequence where compensation is calibrated to be just generous enough to make leaving unaffordable, using golden bars, financial dependence by design, sunk cost exploitation, conditional love and identity hooking to convert a writer's need for financial security and a lifestyle they have built into the loss of portable, transferable earning power. It benefits the party that holds the paper and the catalog. It is hard to detect because the draw is real, the affection is real and the work is often good. What the writer can lose is the freedom to take their talent somewhere else on terms they can afford. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: The Obligation Web
combos.definition: The Obligation Web is the sequence where favors, advances, family claims and delivery duties interlock until cutting one tie tightens others, using obligation installation, obligation hooks, obligation contracts, favor debt, guilt legacy, duty scripts, FOG and demand for gratitude to convert a sense of duty and reciprocity into the loss of the ability to decline a single request without unraveling a web of others. It benefits whoever holds the threads. It is hard to detect because each favor was real and each tie is individually reasonable. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: The Dependency Web
combos.definition: The Dependency Web is the sequence where money, contacts, information and identity all route through one controlling person or entity until the target cannot operate independently, using financial enmeshment, financial dependence by design, isolation, information control, identity hooking, forced dependency, emotional parasitism and "We're Family" erasure to convert a need for stability, identity and belonging into the loss of independent capacity to survive outside the system. In a young performer's career it can occur even when the controlling person is loving and frightened. It is hard to detect because every strand has a protective explanation. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: Forced Dependency
combos.definition: Forced Dependency is the sequence where an artist or crew member's money, contacts, information, resources and health are routed through a system until they cannot practically leave it, using financial enmeshment, isolation, resource sabotage, golden bars, financial dependence by design, information control and health sabotage to convert basic needs for survival, health and information into the loss of the practical ability to leave. It can arise from deliberate design or from careless structure and competing incentives; intent would require additional evidence. It benefits whoever depends on the tour's completion. It is hard to detect because each piece has an ordinary logistical explanation and the comforts are real.

combos.name: The Debt Prison
combos.definition: The Debt Prison is the sequence where financial obligations are structured so they cannot be resolved, discharged or escaped, using financial enmeshment, financial dependence by design, sunk cost exploitation, obligation contracts, guilt legacy and process exhaustion to convert the belief that debts must eventually be resolved into the loss of financial freedom and the ability to ever fully discharge the obligation. It benefits whoever holds the ledger. It is hard to detect because advances are real, recoupment can be legitimate, and complex accounting can have innocent causes. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern is what can be observed.

combos.name: The Loyalty Trap
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Loyalty Trap is the sequence where belonging to a group becomes the collateral for staying in it, using Forced Teaming, "We're Family" Erasure, Guilt Legacy, Obligation Contracts, Conditional Love, and Punishment of Disloyalty to convert an artist's desire to belong into a standing cost of leaving that is paid in friends, standing and reputation. It benefits whoever controls the group's rituals and rules, because a roster that polices its own members needs no clause enforcement. It exploits the real warmth of small-label culture and the loneliness of early careers, and it is hard to detect because the care is often genuine and the penalty arrives socially rather than contractually. What the person may lose is not only a deal but their place among the people who had become their whole professional world, and, as the visible fate of earlier departures suggests, their safety from being made an example. Intent would require additional evidence, since a close community may behave this way through habit rather than design.

combos.name: The Guilt Anchor
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Guilt Anchor is the sequence where one person's displayed suffering becomes the weight that holds another person in place, using Guilt-Tripping, Obligation Hooks, Martyrdom Display, Emotional Hostage-Taking, FOG, and Duty Scripts to convert the target's sense of responsibility for other people's feelings into a loss of freedom to act in their own professional interest. In a family act it benefits the bandleader, whose control is protected by the group's emotional stakes as well as by paper. It exploits guilt-proneness and genuine love, and it is hard to detect because the suffering may be real, the history of care is genuine, and nobody ever says "you may not leave." What the person may lose is the freedom to pursue their own work without carrying another adult's wellbeing as a condition. Intent would require additional evidence, since a distressed parent and a controlling one can look identical from the outside.

combos.name: The Identity Lock
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Identity Lock is the sequence where an artist's public persona is fused to the institution that built it, using Identity Hooking, Labeling, "You've Changed", Social Identity Threat, Conditional Love, and Isolation to convert an artist's need for an authentic self into the belief that leaving the institution means losing who they are. It benefits the party whose investment depends on the persona staying fixed, and it exploits the way public identity, professional identity and private identity blur in a performing career. It is hard to detect because brand building is legitimate, the persona is often partly the artist's own work, and the control is exercised through approval clauses and kind remarks. What the person may lose is a self-concept that exists independent of the deal. Intent would require additional evidence, since label teams also protect real investment in good faith.

combos.name: The Sunk Cost Prison
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Sunk Cost Prison is the sequence where years of investment become the bars that keep an artist in a deal, using Sunk Cost Exploitation, Commitment Traps, Future Faking, Moving Goalposts, FOG, and Learned Helplessness to convert the artist's reluctance to write off the past into a loss of clear judgment about the future. It benefits the party whose delivery standard, option and approvals remain undefined, and it exploits the ordinary human difficulty of treating money and years already spent as gone. It is hard to detect because the work continues, the encouragement is real and each revision request sounds reasonable. What the person may lose is clear-eyed evaluation of the future independent of the past. Intent would require additional evidence, since creative development genuinely takes time and executives do change their minds in good faith.

combos.name: The Bridge Burner
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Bridge Burner is the sequence where leaving is made to feel like exile, using Isolation, Reputation Poisoning, Smear Campaign, Triangulation, FOG, and Hoovering to convert a departing person's need for continued belonging and standing into a loss of the relationships and reputation that would otherwise survive departure. It does not prevent exit; it makes the world on the other side of the door look smaller. It benefits whoever wants departure to be seen as a cautionary tale, and it exploits the smallness of regional music circuits and the way a few trusted voices can shape how many bookers see a person. It is hard to detect because the statements are often phrased as concern, prayer or caution, and the person is the last to learn what has been said. What may be lost is bookings, collaborations and friendships. Intent would require additional evidence, since a company may genuinely need to protect its repertoire and tell partners so.

combos.name: The Hostage Scenario
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Hostage Scenario is the sequence where someone the target loves is used as leverage, using Emotional Hostage-Taking, Threats of Harm, FOG, Guilt-Tripping, Conditional Safety, and Obligation Contracts to convert the target's protective love into silence and compliance. It benefits whoever holds power over the loved one's job, housing or safety, and it exploits the way a family member's employment can place a performer's career and a loved one's wellbeing in the same hands. It is hard to detect because the language is often indirect, deniable and wrapped in concern, and because the target may not be sure what was meant. What the person may lose is the ability to act in their own interest without endangering a loved one. Intent would require additional evidence, since an ambiguous remark can be careless as well as menacing; any suggestion of harm should nonetheless be treated seriously.

combos.name: Pavlovian Conditioning
combos.definition: [SPEAK] Pavlovian Conditioning is the sequence where rewards arrive unpredictably and relief arrives only after compliance, using Intermittent Reinforcement, Negative Reinforcement Traps, Relief Bait, Conditional Love, and Withholding to convert a performer's need to read a precarious situation into a habit of reacting to signals rather than judging the relationship. On tour it concentrates in set-slot allocation, bonus schedules, soundcheck access and informal praise, currencies that support acts and crew cannot easily price or contest. It is hard to detect because each outcome has an ordinary explanation, and the person affected often feels grateful rather than controlled. What can be lost is the ability to read the relationship accurately rather than reactively. Intent would require additional evidence, since a rotation board can be sloppy and generous at once.

combos.name: Obedience Training
combos.definition: [SPEAK] Obedience Training is the sequence where small, mostly meaningless demands are enforced with disproportionate consequences until a performer answers by reflex, using Enforcing Trivial Demands, Behavior Control, Overcorrection Demands, Punishment of Boundaries, Negative Reinforcement Traps, and Group Consolidation to convert a new artist's wish to avoid being labeled difficult into a habit of unquestioning availability. In the label and management economy it concentrates in late-night calls, promotional schedules, social media tone approvals and group chats, because an unclear availability clause lets responsiveness stand in for commitment. It is hard to detect because every demand is small and every individual request can be defended as business. What can be lost is the capacity for independent judgment about which requests matter. Intent would require additional evidence, since eager labels can be disorganized, anxious and demanding without designing anything.

combos.name: Walking on Eggshells
combos.definition: [SPEAK] Walking on Eggshells is the sequence where an unpredictable atmosphere trains the people around it to monitor and manage one person's moods, using Ambient Abuse, Intermittent Reinforcement, Baiting, Punishment of Boundaries, Push-Pull, and Dr. Jekyll/Mr. Hyde to convert a professional's need to keep a show and a team safe into constant vigilance that leaves little attention for self-advocacy or exit. On tour it concentrates around headliners, producers and label heads whose tolerance for dissent is low and whose control over work is high, and it falls on road managers, assistants, crew and band. It is hard to detect because the unpredictability is the mechanism, and because the same person can be generous and exacting in the same day. What can be lost is the attention and energy that would otherwise go into asking for clearer terms, support or an exit. Intent would require additional evidence; stress, exhaustion and a demanding craft can produce similar behavior.

combos.name: The Frog in Boiling Water
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Frog in Boiling Water is the sequence where duties, deductions and expectations rise by steps so small that none triggers alarm, using Boundary Testing, Normalization, Minimization, Commitment Traps, Sunk Cost Exploitation, and Ambient Abuse to convert a worker's adaptability into a tolerated state of worsening conditions. In touring it concentrates in merch, crew and session roles where scope is informal, pay is by the day or by percentage, and settlement documents change line by line. It is hard to detect because each change is small, comes with a reason, and is asked of someone who wants the tour to succeed. What can be lost is the baseline sense of what is normal or acceptable, along with money and time. Intent would require additional evidence, because tours do change, costs do appear, and generous people do ask for help.

combos.name: Learned Silence
combos.definition: [SPEAK] Learned Silence is the sequence where every channel for speaking up is made costly until staying quiet is the only safe choice, using Punishment of Boundaries, Group Consolidation, Pre-Punishment, Ambient Abuse, Baiting, Tone Policing, and Extinction Bursts to convert a crew member's wish to avoid consequences into the habit of not naming problems at all. In touring it concentrates in crew, session players and support staff, whose next job depends on being easy to work with and whose concerns, about safety, pay or credit, are exactly the ones a production prefers not to hear. It is hard to detect because no single act forbids speech; each one makes it a little more expensive. What can be lost is voice, and with it the early warnings that keep people safe. Intent would require additional evidence, since busy productions can be impatient with complaints for ordinary reasons.

combos.name: The Impossible Standard
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Impossible Standard is the sequence where contradictory demands coexist, success is redefined after it is achieved, and failure is framed as personal deficiency rather than the system's design, using Double Binds, Moving Goalposts, Impossible Metrics, Shame Installation, Overcorrection Demands, and Conditional Love to convert a creator's legitimate wish to meet professional expectations into a belief that effort can never be enough. In library and sync work it concentrates in revision cycles, delivery commitments with undefined standards and feedback chains passed through several people. It is hard to detect because every note sounds reasonable and many are, and because the worker is rewarded for responsiveness. What can be lost is unpaid time, income and the sense that any effort can be sufficient. Intent would require additional evidence, since clients genuinely change their minds and feedback chains genuinely contradict themselves.

combos.name: The Rigged Game
combos.definition: [SPEAK] The Rigged Game is the sequence where a system that claims to be fair is calibrated so that losses belong to the target and wins belong to someone else, using Impossible Metrics, Moving Goalposts, Double Binds, Scapegoating, Credit Theft, Shame Installation, and Malicious Compliance to convert a professional's belief in fair evaluation into self-blame and eventual disengagement. In the label world it concentrates in A&R and junior staff scoring, split-sheet and credit decisions, and delivery targets, where contribution is real but attribution is controlled by the person above. It is hard to detect because the process looks fair from outside, with scorecards, ratings and reviews, and each judgment can be defended in isolation. What can be lost is trust in evaluation and the willingness to keep trying. Intent would require additional evidence, since managers can be forgetful, overloaded and sincerely convinced of their own role.

combos.name: The Loyalty Test
combos.definition: The Loyalty Test is the sequence where a moment of pressure is turned into a demonstration of allegiance, using Manufactured Urgency, False Dilemma, Duty Scripts, Baiting, Enforcing Trivial Demands, Conditional Love and Punishment of Boundaries to convert the wish to belong and to be seen as dependable into the loss of the ability to hesitate without being treated as disloyal. It benefits whoever relies on the person's compliance in the moment, and it exploits real stakes: crews, promoters, ticket-holders, penalty schedules. That is what makes it hard to detect, since shows do have deadlines and managers do care. What may be lost is the standing to ask a question at all. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Approval Addiction
combos.definition: The Approval Addiction is the sequence where praise and criticism from a powerful, admired figure are alternated until a person's sense of worth depends on that figure's opinion, using Conditional Love, Intermittent Reinforcement, Pedestal Ploy, Negging, Shame Installation and Identity Hooking to convert the need for approval from an intermittently warm authority into the loss of an independent basis for self-worth. It benefits whoever relies on the person's effort, availability and loyalty, and it exploits real features of the sector: mentorship that does open doors, session notes that are normal, reference letters that matter. It is hard to detect because genuine mentors also praise, criticize and gatekeep. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: Performance Extraction
combos.definition: Performance Extraction is the sequence where maximum effort is obtained for minimum return by always placing the reward just ahead, using Future Faking, Sunk Cost Exploitation, Bread-crumbing, Intermittent Reinforcement, Conditional Love, Manufactured Scarcity and Moving Goalposts to convert motivation from promised future reward into the loss of fair compensation for effort already delivered. It benefits whoever receives the work, and it exploits the sector's real currency of visibility, credit and access. It is hard to detect because credits and exposure genuinely have value, and some small collaborations do lead to paid work. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Burnout Machine
combos.definition: The Burnout Machine is the sequence where relentless demands, shifting expectations and manufactured crises deplete a person while moral framing makes rest feel like failure, using Ritualized Exhaustion, Impossible Metrics, Moving Goalposts, Duty Scripts, Guilt-Tripping, Performance Extraction and Strategic Chaos to convert a sense of duty and the desire to be seen as dedicated into the loss of rest and the right to name exhaustion without being blamed for it. It benefits whoever relies on the output, and it exploits real features of the sector: content calendars, benchmarks, release schedules and platforms that reward consistency. It is hard to detect because each demand is plausible and the exhaustion is later described as a personal limit. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Compliance Engine
combos.definition: The Compliance Engine is the sequence where a layered system of arbitrary rules, uneven rewards and visible consequences builds obedience until resisting seems impossible, using Behavior Control, Enforcing Trivial Demands, Negative Reinforcement Traps, Intermittent Reinforcement, Conditional Love, Group Consolidation, Punishment of Boundaries and Demonstrating Omnipotence to convert a person's wish to avoid arbitrary consequences into time and attention diverted into compliance rituals. It benefits whoever relies on the person's predictability, and it exploits real sector features: image provisions, approval rights and heavy scheduling. It is hard to detect because duty of care, branding and wellness support are legitimate, and each step can be presented as help. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Compliance Cascade
combos.definition: The Compliance Cascade is the sequence where a series of small, reasonable-seeming requests, paired with reinforcement, adds up to a large commitment, using Foot-in-the-Door, Graduated Compliance, Reward/Punishment Cycling, Normalization, Authority Worship and Learned Compliance to convert a willingness to agree to small asks into the loss of the ability to recognize when a series of small asks has become a large one. It benefits whoever collects the commitments, and it exploits real features of the sector: co-writes, tight room bookings, unsigned paperwork and deference to senior credits. It is hard to detect because each step is ordinary and many sessions legitimately work this way. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Reward Maze
combos.definition: The Reward Maze is the sequence where an institutional reward system replaces a person's own reasons with the pursuit of the next measurable reward, using Token Economy, Intermittent Reinforcement, Variable Ratio Reinforcement, Conditional Worth, Moving Goalposts, Performance Addiction and Identity Hooking to convert responsiveness to measurable recognition into the loss of intrinsic motivation and a self-directed sense of purpose. It benefits whoever receives the free promotion, and it exploits real features of the sector: fandom, scarce access, leaderboards, playlist and chart milestones. It is hard to detect because enthusiasm is real, fans often love the work, and recognition feels like generosity. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Normalization Engine
combos.definition: The Normalization Engine is the sequence where conditions worsen in steps too small to refuse, each step is repeated until it feels like fact, and the target learns to treat the newest condition as the baseline, using Gradual Escalation, Repetition as Truth, Social Proof, "That's Just How It Is," Anchoring, Gaslighting, and Window Shifting to convert adaptability into the loss of the original reference point. It benefits whoever profits from a schedule or workload that grows without a decision ever being announced. It is hard to detect because no single step is dramatic, the person usually agreed to each one, and their own records can seem to confirm they consented. What may be lost is the memory of what was agreed, and with it the ability to say that something changed; in touring, where fatigue carries physical risk, the cost may include safety. Intent would require additional evidence, since the same shape can arise from real, unspoken pressure.

combos.name: The Silence Training
combos.definition: The Silence Training is the sequence where speaking up is made costly, the cost is made visible to everyone, and compliance is rewarded until the group stops speaking before anyone has to be told to, using Punishment of Voice, Public Shaming, Reward of Compliance, Social Proof, Fear Installation, Self-Censorship, and Chilling Effect to convert the ordinary wish to avoid social cost into the loss of a collective voice. It benefits whoever gains from an unquestioned roster. It is hard to detect because no instruction is given, the lesson is carried by an example, and a guideline can be written in the language of brand and positivity. What may be lost is the willingness to say what is true, and the group's shared ability to object. Observable consequences (a departure, a memo, a spotlight) must be kept separate from inferred reasons, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Learned Helplessness Machine
combos.definition: The Learned Helplessness Machine is the sequence where effort meets decisions no one owns, outcomes that do not respond to what the person does, and a process long enough to wear them out, using Arbitrary Authority, Uncontrollable Outcomes, Process Exhaustion, Gaslighting, Minimization, Learned Helplessness, and Apathy Installation to convert belief that effort produces results into the loss of that belief. It benefits whoever would otherwise have to pay, correct or answer. It is hard to detect because every individual response is polite, procedural and plausible, and because slow administration is also a normal, honest condition of the sector. What may be lost is money owed, the habit of trying, and the person's sense of their own competence. This pattern is described by its effect on the claimant; intent would require additional evidence, and ordinary understaffing, fragmented rights and genuine backlog can produce the same experience without any design.

combos.name: The Perfectionism Trap
combos.definition: The Perfectionism Trap is the sequence where a standard is set so high and so unstable that the target can never arrive, using Impossible Standards, Conditional Worth, Comparative Devaluation, Moving Goalposts, Shame Cycling, Internalized Critic, and Performance Addiction to convert the drive to meet a self-set high standard into permanent inadequacy. It benefits whoever profits from more output, more takes, more compliance, or a more malleable artist. It exploits the real ambition of a young performer and the genuine value of craft. It is hard to detect because rigor, high standards and "one more take" are also what excellent producers do, and the person often experiences the pressure as their own. What may be lost is the sense that rest, a good-enough take or a finished song can ever count. Intent would require additional evidence, and real creative rigor must be told apart from this pattern.

combos.name: The Obedience Ladder
combos.definition: The Obedience Ladder is the sequence where a small, easy request is followed by slightly larger ones, each justified by authority and shared among many hands, until the target is doing what they would have refused at the start, using Foot-in-the-Door, Authority Worship, Graduated Compliance, Diffusion of Responsibility, Moral Disengagement, Normalization, and "Just Following Orders" to convert trust that small compromises will not compound into a large one into a position of personal exposure. It benefits whoever wants a result that others will not support in full view. It is hard to detect because each step is nearly identical to the one before, the requests come from someone admired, and the target helped build the ladder with their own hands. What may be lost is the person's integrity as they understand it, their professional reputation, and their trust in their own judgment. This script describes a pattern of pressure on junior staff; it makes no assertion about what any real person did or about legal responsibility, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Gaslighting Machine
combos.definition: The Gaslighting Machine is the sequence where a verbal promise about terms, credit or control is denied, rewritten, shrunk, reversed and repeated until the person who heard it stops trusting their own recall, using Gaslighting, Revisionist History, Minimization, DARVO, Plausible Deniability and Repetition as Truth to convert trust in one's own memory into lost confidence in one's own account of events. It tends to benefit whoever holds the paper, because the paper survives and the conversation does not. It exploits an industry where consequential promises are made at consoles and in kitchens before anyone asks for a document. It is hard to detect because every step can resemble an honest difference of recollection. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Reality Replacement
combos.definition: Reality Replacement is the sequence where an account of events is re-authored, repeated and endorsed until it takes the place of the original, using Revisionist History, Repetition as Truth, Social Proof, Information Control, Gaslighting and Memory Flooding to convert reliance on institutional accounts into the loss of an accurate, shared version of what happened. In music it concentrates in heritage pages, anniversary editions, liner notes and catalog narratives, because the institution that holds the archive also writes the history. It is hard to detect because curation is legitimate, celebration is sincere, and a gap can look like a space limit. What the target can lose is the shared record of what happened to a person, a project or a family. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Confusion Protocol
combos.definition: The Confusion Protocol is the sequence where a document or conversation is made so tangled, circular and crowded that the person with the question stops asking it, using Word Salad, Circular Logic, Strategic Ambiguity, Cognitive Overload, Moving Goalposts and Topic Switching to convert limited capacity for sustained focus under overload into the loss of the original concern ever being addressed. In music publishing it concentrates in amendments built from cross-referenced definitions, schedules and portals, where an ordinary person must read three sections to understand one sentence. It is hard to detect because every sentence can be defended as accurate, and because real contracts are genuinely dense. What the target can lose is the answer to the question they came with. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Memory Hole
combos.definition: The Memory Hole is the sequence where records, versions and witnesses are removed or recast until an event can no longer be shown to have happened as it did, using Revisionist History, Information Control, Social Proof, Gaslighting, Document Destruction and Repetition as Truth to convert dependence on records and witnesses into the loss of documented proof. In touring and settlement work it concentrates in shared drives, retention schedules, draft-versus-final language and verbal recaps, because the people who hold the numbers are often not the people who benefit from them. It is hard to detect because deletion looks like housekeeping, and because drafts are legitimately replaced. What the target can lose is the proof that a figure, a promise or a version ever existed. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The False Narrative
combos.definition: The False Narrative is the sequence where an inaccurate account of events is framed, spread and repeated until the person who disputes it is recast as the problem, using False Framing, Smear Campaign, Reputation Poisoning, Social Proof, Gaslighting, Repetition as Truth and Information Control to convert trust that a stated account is accurate into damage to reputation and to the accurate record of who did what. In music it concentrates in press statements, band-split announcements, publicity chains and leaked chats, because the people who write the story are the people who control access to the press. It is hard to detect because the false piece is usually small, and because the messenger is easier to discredit than the message is to prove wrong. What the target can lose is reputation, standing and the accurate record. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Double Bind Trap
combos.definition: The Double Bind Trap is the sequence where two instructions that contradict each other are placed in the same document, so that any action can be framed as a failure, using Double Binds, Moving Goalposts, Gaslighting, Shame Installation, DARVO and Conditional Love to convert a person's desire to find the correct or safe response into the loss of any workable choice and of the belief that a right answer exists. In festival booking it concentrates in promotion obligations paired with exclusivity and radius terms, and in tone sheets that are issued after signing. It is hard to detect because each clause alone is ordinary, and because the conflict appears only when both are read together. What the target can lose is leverage, standing and confidence. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Perspective Poisoning
combos.definition: Perspective Poisoning is the sequence where the frame is installed before the evidence arrives, so that new information is read through a lens the person did not choose, using Anchoring, False Framing, Selective Disclosure, Information Control, Repetition as Truth, Social Proof and Priming to convert the tendency to interpret new information through an already-set frame into the loss of neutral, independent interpretation. In music it concentrates in press packets, review excerpts, label summaries and "how it landed" meetings, because the person who curates the reception is often the person who explains it. It is hard to detect because every quote is real and the curator may sincerely mean to protect. What the target can lose is a first-hand reading of their own work's reception. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Meaning Hijack
combos.definition: The Meaning Hijack is the sequence where warm, familiar words are kept deliberately open and then redefined in the document to mean something narrower, using Strategic Ambiguity, Redefining Terms, False Framing, Repetition as Truth, Social Proof and Information Control to convert trust that positive words mean what they have always meant into the loss of stable, shared meaning for key terms. In music it concentrates in words such as "partner," "ownership," "family," "net," "recoupable" and "standard," which carry emotional weight and whose contractual meanings can be narrow. It is hard to detect because the warm meaning is spoken constantly and the narrow one appears once, in a definitions section. What the target can lose is the shared meaning of the terms they relied on, and what those terms were supposed to secure. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Blame Reversal Engine
combos.definition: The Blame Reversal Engine is the sequence where a complaint is turned around so that the person who raised it becomes the person under review, using DARVO, Preemptive Documentation, Tone Policing, Diagnostic Deflection, Source Poisoning and Record Inversion to convert a reporter's trust in fair process into the loss of their standing as the injured party. In the music industry it concentrates around assistants, junior staff, crew and session players, who raise a pay or credit question to someone who also controls their next booking, reference or paycheck. It is hard to detect because every step can be presented as ordinary management. What may be lost is the job, a reputation in a small industry, and the plain fact that they asked a legitimate question first. Intent would require additional evidence beyond the pattern.

combos.name: The Investigation Theater
combos.definition: The Investigation Theater is the sequence where an institution performs the appearance of investigating a complaint while the process delays, turns its attention to the person who complained, withholds its reasoning and ends in an outcome that changes nothing but the complainant's file, using Performative Reception, Strategic Delay, Investigative Inversion, Opacity Shield, Visible Non-Consequence and Retroactive Repositioning to convert belief in fair process into lost time, lost evidence and a lost chance of a real outcome. In music it concentrates in the gap between artists and the label personnel who control their credits, sessions and release schedules, where a complaint is handled by the same organization that benefits from the status quo. It is hard to detect because the steps are courteous and procedurally correct. Intent would require additional evidence, and many reviews that end this way are simply poor, underpowered or conflicted processes.

combos.name: The Circular Referral Loop
combos.definition: The Circular Referral Loop is the sequence where a royalty or credit question is met with sympathy by everyone and ownership by no one, using Sympathetic Intake, Authority Displacement, Procedural Embedding, Timeline Exploitation, Accountability Diffusion and Exhaustion Yield to convert trust that each party in a chain is helping into time, energy and a resolution that never arrives. In music it concentrates where rights and money are split among a label, a publisher, a distributor, a collection body and accountants, so that each can honestly say the answer sits elsewhere. It is hard to detect because every individual is kind, every referral is plausible and no one ever says no. What may be lost is unpaid income, an accurate registration and months of attention. Intent would require additional evidence, since fragmented rights alone can produce this result.

combos.name: The Paper Trail Fabrication
combos.definition: The Paper Trail Fabrication is the sequence where dissent triggers the quiet construction of a file, in which real events are rewritten, ordinary entries accumulate into an unfavorable portrait and the finished record is cited as the objective reason for a decision, using Trigger Identification, Retroactive Recharacterization, Pattern Seeding, Asymmetric Curation, Access Delay and Institutional Citation to convert the assumption that a personnel file reflects reality into lost job security and an inaccurate record of one's own work. In the music business it concentrates in label and management departments where roles are small, evaluation is informal and a reference carries heavy weight. It is hard to detect because each note can look like ordinary management paperwork. Intent would require additional evidence, and a file built after a conflict may also reflect honest, if belated, concerns.

combos.name: The Policy Shield
combos.definition: The Policy Shield is the sequence where a safety, pay or credit complaint is welcomed and then buried in forms, office transfers and formatting requirements, so that the policy protects the institution from the complaint rather than the person from the harm, using Procedural Legitimation, Form Gatekeeping, Jurisdictional Displacement, Documentation Extraction, Capacity Dilution and Unilateral Resolution to convert trust that a written policy protects those harmed into the loss of a timely and substantive resolution. In live entertainment it concentrates where venue, production, promoter and touring crew each hold part of the responsibility and each has its own form. It is hard to detect because every step is compliant with a policy, and everyone is polite. Intent would require additional evidence, and many such gaps are the unplanned product of divided responsibility.

combos.name: The Scapegoat Funnel
combos.definition: The Scapegoat Funnel is the sequence where a person is recruited with language of trust and mission, given verbal-only approval, made the single public face of a shared decision and then severed from ownership when backlash arrives, using Mission Framing, Verbal Authorization, Visibility Inversion, Pressure Accumulation, Narrative Severance and Sacrificial Repositioning to convert willingness to represent a decision into the loss of institutional backing at the moment it is needed. In live music it concentrates around festival cancellations, lineup changes, ticketing and safety announcements, where a spokesperson, tour manager or junior staff member is put at the front of a decision made by others. It is hard to detect because every step can look like trust and urgency. Intent would require additional evidence, and a confused organization under pressure can produce the same shape without a plan.

combos.name: The Confidentiality Cage
combos.definition: The Confidentiality Cage is the sequence where a reporter's compliance with the proper channel is turned against them, using Dutiful Reporting, Legal Authority Transfer, Confidentiality Weaponization, Access Severance, Quiet Resolution and Permanent Silencing to convert the belief that following the proper reporting channel is protective into the loss of the ability to discuss a concern beyond the sanctioned channel. In music and entertainment it concentrates around productions that involve minors, where welfare reporting runs through the production's own management and counsel, and where a reference, a rebooking or a payment is at stake. It is hard to detect because each step is framed as protecting the child, the reporter or a proper process. A concern about a minor, however, belongs with child-protection professionals, not only inside a company. Intent would require additional evidence, and many companies handle such reports earnestly.

combos.name: The Apology Substitute
combos.definition: The Apology Substitute is the sequence where an organization answers a harm quickly and warmly but never names it, using Responsive Velocity, Values Broadcasting, Abstraction Escalation, Agent Erasure, Victim Redirection and Resolution Without Acknowledgment to convert a person's need to be acknowledged into a wellness referral and a file that shows only compassion. It can function as a substitute because speed and kindness are easy to verify, while a named acknowledgment is the one thing the file never has to contain. It exploits the desire for acknowledgment after harm, and it is hard to detect because every step looks like good conduct. What the person may lose is the specific, named recognition of what happened to them, and with it the ordinary pathway to repair and prevention. Intent would require additional evidence; much of this is simply how cautious organizations behave under legal pressure.

combos.name: The Collective Punishment Deflector
combos.definition: The Collective Punishment Deflector is the sequence where an authority registers a problem but declines to assign it to a person, then imposes a consequence on the whole group, recruits the group itself to police the outcome, recasts the penalty as a moral lesson, and trains everyone not to question it — using Incident Identification Without Individual Accountability, Collective Consequence, Peer Pressure Weaponization, Moral Reframing, Silence Installation and Retroactive Justification to convert the group's trust that responsibility will be assigned accurately into standing and goodwill lost among peers. It benefits the party that would otherwise have to document and defend an individual decision. It is hard to detect in touring companies because shared bus calls, shared per-diems and the language of family already make group consequences feel normal, and some are legitimate. What can be lost is standing within the group and trust among the people you work beside every day.

combos.name: The Whistleblower Inversion
combos.definition: The Whistleblower Inversion is the sequence where a good-faith report is turned around so that the reporter becomes the subject of concern, using Internal Exhaustion Prerequisite, External Trigger Escalation, Surveillance Activation, Phantom Complaint Injection, Professional Degradation and Geographic Displacement to convert trust in internal channels into reputational loss and the loss of the paper trail that showed the report was valid. It can function this way even when each step is individually defensible: a review, an observation, a development move. It is hard to detect because the institution speaks the language of support and the reporter's own record is rewritten as the context. What may be lost is professional reputation, standing, and the continuity of the documents proving the report was made first and in good faith. Intent would require additional evidence, and retaliation questions are legal ones that depend on the jurisdiction and facts.

combos.name: The Statute of Limitations Exploit
combos.definition: The Statute of Limitations Exploit is the sequence where the way harm is grown, quietly and over years, makes it impossible to recognize inside the period in which formal action is possible, using Delayed Recognition Architecture, Institutional Intake Performance, Legal Gatekeeping, Obligation Erasure, Responsibility Displacement and Active Danger Preservation to convert a person's reliance on timely institutional response into a lost window. A process that welcomes a disclosure warmly and then closes it on timing can leave the burden with the person and access to young people unchanged, even if no one designed it. It is hard to detect because the intake is real and the rejection is polite. What may be lost is the legal or practical window in which action was possible; time limits vary widely by place and may be paused or extended in some settings [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC]. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The "Both Sides" Equalizer
combos.definition: The "Both Sides" Equalizer is the sequence where a one-directional harm is recharacterized as a two-way conflict, using Conflict Reframing, Procedural Symmetry, Mutual Agreement Fabrication, File Equalization, Privacy Weaponization and Closure Manufacture to convert a person's trust that a resolution process weighs facts into the loss of recognition of who was actually harmed. It can function as the opposite of fairness while looking like fairness itself: identical treatment of unequal situations. It is hard to detect because genuine mutual conflict is common in bands and a balanced process is often the correct one. What the person may lose is the record that one side was harmed, along with credit, standing and the ability to raise the original issue. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The NDA Silencer
combos.definition: The NDA Silencer is the sequence where years of unaddressed reports end in a public crisis and a payment is offered in exchange for silence, using Systemic Neglect Documentation, Crisis-Triggered Repair, Reputational Threat Conversion, Economic Coercion, Consent Fabrication and Institutional Memory Erasure to convert a person's need for closure and for financial stability into a lasting inability to warn others. It can function as a clean ending for the organization and a permanent one for the witness. It is hard to detect because the money is real, the confidentiality is normal-looking, and the signature is voluntary on paper. What the person may lose is the ability to warn the next person and to speak to people who could help, and the institution may lose its own memory of what occurred. Confidentiality itself is often legitimate; intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Voluntary Departure Rewrite
combos.definition: The Voluntary Departure Rewrite is the sequence where a person's success is recast as a poor fit, every option on offer is an exit, and the exit is narrated as their own free decision, using Values Misalignment Manufacturing, Binary Choice Construction, Positive Reference Leverage, Voluntary Narrative Installation, Community Confusion Exploitation and Legacy Erasure to convert a desire to leave with dignity into the loss of public credit and the continuity of the work. It can function as a quiet removal that leaves no visible removal. It is hard to detect because each step is gracious and the most important choice, whether to leave at all, is taken before the meeting. What the person may lose is public credit for what they built and the survival of the programs they led. Many departures really are voluntary and mutual; intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Isolated Incident Quarantine
combos.definition: The Isolated Incident Quarantine is the sequence where each report is handled and closed at the level of a single site, so that cases are never compared, using Campus-Level Containment, Case Closure Protocol, Cross-Campus Blindness, Aggregate Reporting Substitution, Policy Adequacy Defense and Accountability Fragmentation to convert the reporter's trust that each concern is being tracked at a system level into the loss of visibility of the pattern. It benefits whoever would otherwise have to act on it. It is hard to detect because every individual closure is procedurally proper, and the aggregate numbers look like success. In a touring festival brand, regional editions, subcontracted crews and volunteer rotation make the separation natural. What can be lost is the ability for anyone to recognize a series as a series.

combos.name: The Expert Validation Shield
combos.definition: The Expert Validation Shield is the sequence where a decision made in advance is carried through a process of outside review and a vote, using Pre-Decision Concealment, Expert Procurement, Process Performance, Credential Asymmetry Deployment, Language Laundering and Democratic Validation to convert trust that expert review precedes a decision into the loss of a real chance to influence it. It can function as a shield: the expert's competence, the process's formality and the vote's legitimacy each protect the outcome from challenge. It is hard to detect because the expert may be honest, the data genuine and the vote real; what is missing is the order in which things happened and the framing of the question. What the person may lose is a genuine opportunity to influence the outcome. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The DARVO Cascade
combos.definition: The DARVO Cascade is the sequence where a concern raised by a lower-power person is met with denial, an attack on the person raising it, and a claim that the one complained about is the real injured party, using DARVO, Role Reversal Traps, Preemptive Accusation, Complaint Weaponization, Pity Plays, Weaponized Tears and Credibility Theft to convert the reporter's trust that a concern will be received in good faith into a loss of standing as a credible reporter rather than a suspect. It may benefit whoever holds the money, the relationships or the reputation in the room, because the complaint stops being a question about conduct and becomes a question about the complainant. It exploits the sector's dependence on reputation, short engagements and who-hired-whom loyalty, and it is hard to detect because each step can be presented as fairness, concern for wellbeing or ordinary process. The reporter may lose their credibility, their next booking, their sense of what actually happened, and the chance that the original concern is ever examined. Whether any given case is deliberate design or a defensive reflex under pressure would require additional evidence beyond the pattern itself.

combos.name: The Accountability Firewall
combos.definition: The Accountability Firewall is the sequence where a legitimate accountability question is met with a series of layered defenses, each of which redirects, reflects, confuses or absorbs the question, using Deflection, Whataboutism, Projection, Contradiction Stacking, Non-Apology Apology, Role Reversal Traps, Burden of Proof Shifting and Diffusion of Responsibility to convert a person's persistence in pursuing a fair question into lost time, energy and the practical chance of getting an answer. It may benefit whichever party holds the figures, the systems and the paper, because no single layer has to defeat the question; each only needs to slow it enough for the next to engage. It exploits the sector's reliance on long, cross-referenced agreements, opaque royalty accounting and the habit of treating "both sides were represented" as the end of a conversation. It is hard to detect because every layer can be presented as courtesy, complexity or ordinary process. What the person may lose is months of effort, money in legal fees, and the belief that a clear question deserves a clear answer. Whether the layering reflects design, disorganization or a genuinely complex structure would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Accountability Black Hole
combos.definition: The Accountability Black Hole is the sequence where a question about credit, ownership or money enters an organization or a network of organizations and never exits with an answer, using Diffusion of Responsibility, Plausible Deniability, Process Exhaustion, HR Shielding, Confidentiality as Weapon, Pseudo-Consultation and Paper-Trail Traps to convert a writer's trust that someone, somewhere, owns the problem into the loss of a clear point of responsibility to direct the concern toward. It may benefit any party whose interest is served by the record staying as it is, because each participant performs a function without producing a result. It exploits the sector's real fragmentation across publishers, labels, distributors, rights organizations and producers' representatives, and it is hard to detect because every individual response is courteous and procedurally correct. The writer may lose years of effort, the credit and share of a song, income attached to it, and the belief that a clear question has a clear owner. Whether this reflects design, drift or the genuine complexity of fragmented rights would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Concern Masking
combos.definition: Concern Masking is the sequence where control, criticism and professional destruction are delivered in the language of care, using Concern Trolling, Plausible Deniability, Tone Policing, Shame-as-Governance Disguised as Advice and Performative Public Affection to convert a person's openness to feedback framed as helpful advice into a loss of the ability to distinguish genuine advice from disguised control. It may benefit a mentor or institution whose standing, influence or preferred outcomes are served by the protege staying smaller, more compliant or more dependent. It exploits the sector's reliance on mentorship, sponsor relationships and reputation, and it is hard to detect because each note is individually defensible, each emotional response is cited as proof of the deficit, and public warmth makes private harm hard to speak. The person may lose confidence in their own judgment, creative direction, relationships with others in the industry and the sense that a sharp feeling is evidence of something wrong. Whether the pattern reflects deliberate design, an anxious or controlling style, or clumsy but sincere care would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Velvet Glove Control
combos.definition: Velvet Glove Control is the sequence where control is exercised so smoothly that naming it makes the target sound paranoid, using Counterfeit Calm, Plausible Deniability, Performative Public Affection, Concern Masking, Clinical Tone Policing and Shame-as-Governance Disguised as Advice to convert trust in a leader who frames control as care into a loss of autonomy in decisions that are being made for them. It may benefit whoever holds the relationship, the schedule and the information, because the artist's choices are shaped without a single instruction to refuse. It exploits the sector's reliance on managers who handle the business, the artist's wish to be spared conflict, and the real vulnerability of creative work to stress, and it is hard to detect because every directive is framed as a suggestion, composure makes any emotional response seem disproportionate, and public warmth contradicts private complaint. The person may lose control of their calendar, releases, collaborations and income decisions, and the confidence that their own preferences are legitimate. Whether the pattern reflects deliberate strategy, a protective temperament or genuinely good strategic advice delivered gently would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Velvet Threat
combos.definition: The Velvet Threat is the sequence where a threat is delivered so softly that it cannot be quoted or reported, using Ambient Abuse, Plausible Deniability, Counterfeit Calm, Legal/Administrative Threats, Demonstrating Omnipotence and Ambiguity as Weapon to convert a person's need for institutional standing and predictable treatment into the loss of any specific, reportable statement to point to. It may benefit whoever holds the licence, the booking, the contract or the room, because the person who raised a concern is brought back into line without anyone having said a word that could be recorded as pressure. It exploits the sector's dependence on venues, promoters and informal relationships, the very real role of licensing, inspection and renewal, and the way a quiet remark can carry an entire institution behind it. It is hard to detect because calm delivery makes a fear response seem irrational, legitimate processes are implied rather than invoked, and ambiguity lets the person fill the gap with their own worst case. The person may lose their sense of proportion, their willingness to raise concerns, their work and the ability to describe what happened. Whether a remark was a threat, a coincidence or an honest comment about a stressful period would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Isolation Campaign
combos.definition: The Isolation Campaign is the sequence where a person who voiced an independent view is removed from the social life of a working group without any single act that can be named, using Trigger Cataloging, Silent Coalition Building, Access Removal, Narrative Injection, Ambient Exclusion, and Self-Exile Completion to convert a need for continued belonging into the loss of community and of the ability to take part without unexplained exclusion. It can function as a way to reach the result of a firing, the person's departure, with no decision, decision-maker or paper to question. It is hard to detect because every step has an ordinary explanation. The target can lose paid calls, years of relationships, access to the rooms where the next job is mentioned, and confidence in their own read of events. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Reputation Assassination
combos.definition: The Reputation Assassination is the sequence where a vague, untraceable rumor is released at the moment a person's standing matters most, using Strategic Timing, Untraceable Seeding, Institutional Contamination, Narrative Mutation, Social Proof Amplification, and Strategic Dissolution to convert reliance on a reputation built over years into the loss of standing at the exact moment it counts. It can function as a way to remove a competitor or a dissenter from a decision without anyone having to make a case against them. It is hard to detect because the rumor never has to be true, specific or attributed, and because it disappears after the decision is made. The target can lose a placement, a client list, referrals and the confidence of people who once vouched for them. Intent would require additional evidence, since honest concerns and ordinary gossip can look the same.

combos.name: The Flying Monkey Network
combos.definition: The Flying Monkey Network is the sequence where a complaint made in confidence reaches people it was never meant to reach, who then press the complainant to drop it without any institution appearing to do so, using Complaint Leaking, Proxy Recruitment, Social Pressure Layering, Plausible Deniability, Community Reframing, and Withdrawal Pressure to convert trust that a confidential complaint will stay confidential into loss of control over who knows about it and when. It can function as a way to apply institutional pressure without institutional fingerprints. It is hard to detect because each caller is a friend or colleague acting in apparent good faith, and because the institution can truthfully say it asked no one to call. The person may lose their sense of safety in reporting, working relationships, bookings, and the practical ability to see the complaint through. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Pile-On Engine
combos.definition: The Pile-On Engine is the sequence where one short moment is cut loose from everything around it, pushed through platforms until it looks like a verdict, and then used by the people who could have defended the person to justify stepping back — using Moment Extraction, Context Elimination, Platform Amplification, Petition Legitimation, Institutional Paralysis, and Permanent Digital Residue to convert a performer's exposure to being judged by their worst seven seconds into a lasting, searchable record nobody has to answer for. It is hard to detect because each participant sees only a small piece, and no one in the chain needs to intend harm for the whole to produce it. In music, where bookings, playlisting and brand deals are decided quickly and informally, what can be lost is work, a gatekeeper's confidence, and a search result that never stops being the first thing a stranger sees.

combos.name: The Social Proof Trap
combos.definition: The Social Proof Trap is the sequence where a decision is announced as already made, the first few voices make it look popular, silence is collected and written down as consent, and each person privately concludes they are the only one who disagrees — using Authority Presentation, Early Endorsement Seeding, Silence Harvesting, Pluralistic Ignorance Installation, Compliance Cascade, and Retroactive Justification to convert people's natural assumption that visible agreement reflects actual agreement into accurate knowledge lost about where the group stands. It benefits whoever wants a change without the cost of a negotiation. It is hard to detect because nobody lies: people really did nod, and nobody really did object. In music, where bands run on loyalty, reputation and unwritten arrangements, what can be lost is pay, dates, a fair hearing and the one thing a group needs in order to push back, which is knowing that it can.

combos.name: The Triangulation Web
combos.definition: The Triangulation Web is the sequence where one person passes selective, confidential information to two people who would otherwise settle matters by talking to each other, until each withdraws from the other and the go-between becomes the only route between them — using Confidential Disclosure Seeding, Selective Truth Weaponization, Defensive Withdrawal Induction, Mirror Operation, Central Positioning, and Dependency Installation to convert the trust two people place in direct conversation into a relationship curated by a third party. It benefits whoever sits in the middle. It is hard to detect because each statement may be partly true and nobody can verify the other side. In music, where managers, A&R staff and publicists routinely carry messages, what can be lost is a working relationship, a creative partnership and the direct line between collaborators.

combos.name: The Public Shaming Ritual
combos.definition: The Public Shaming Ritual is the sequence where an ordinary failure is displayed before a group, reframed as a character flaw, and used to teach everyone watching what will happen to them — using Public Identification, Moral Framing, Audience Activation, Social License Generation, Correction Invisibility, and Internalized Surveillance to convert the natural fear of failing in front of colleagues into permanent self-monitoring. It benefits whoever wants compliance without having to negotiate it. It is hard to detect because it is presented as transparency, accountability and mentorship. In music and entertainment, where interns, junior staff and assistants depend on references, introductions and access, what can be lost is the safety to make an ordinary mistake, the privacy around it, and the sense that a record of a failure will be matched by a record of its repair.

combos.name: The Alliance Fracture
combos.definition: The Alliance Fracture is the sequence where one moderate member of a group is chosen, given private access that others do not have, and bound to silence about it, so that their changed position cannot be explained and the group begins to doubt itself — using Target Selection, Exclusive Access, Information Asymmetry, Confidentiality Binding, Reentry Disruption, and Momentum Collapse to convert a coalition's trust that access is shared honestly into division and lost visibility. It benefits whoever faces the group. It is hard to detect because offers of dialogue are genuinely reasonable and confidentiality is often legitimate. In the music industry, where artist groups rely on a few visible voices and where information about royalty methods is closely held, what can be lost is unity, credibility and the leverage that comes from speaking with one voice.

combos.name: Social Currency Manipulation
combos.definition: Social Currency Manipulation is the sequence where a newcomer's need to belong is met quickly and visibly, small favors establish a pattern of exchange, the asks grow heavier, and belonging is then redefined as a debt that can be called in or withdrawn — using Vulnerability Identification, Social Elevation, Reciprocity Activation, Escalation Testing, Social Debt Invocation, and Revocation Threat to convert a person's isolation into indefinite compliance. It benefits whoever controls access. It is hard to detect because the early generosity is real, the rooms are real, and most of the asks are plausible favors. In music and nightlife, where visibility, guest lists, introductions and bookings are the currencies, what can be lost is independent status, paid work and a standing that does not depend on one person's approval.

combos.name: Character Assassination
combos.definition: Character Assassination is the sequence where a person's standing is replaced, not argued with, by distributing a more convenient version of who they are through channels that never need to face them, using Smear Campaigns, Credibility Theft, Labeling as Identity Warfare, Reputation Laundering, Information Cascades, and Priming to convert a professional's dependence on reputation into the loss of standing that took years to build. It exploits the way reputation travels in a referral-driven industry: through short sentences and group threads rather than documents anyone can check. It is hard to detect because no single remark looks like an attack, because the target is often the last to hear it, and because any defense can be recast as proof of the label. What can be lost is bookings, referrals, collaborators, and the quiet assumption of good faith that makes a long career workable. Whether any one participant intended harm would require additional evidence; the pattern is identifiable by its shape, not by assuming motives.

combos.name: Social Death
combos.definition: Social Death is the sequence where a person who reported misconduct is removed from the social world they depended on, not by a formal decision but by a coordinated withdrawal, using Ostracism, Smear Campaigns, Silent Coalitions, Reputation Warfare, Information Cascades, Doxxing, Context Collapse, and Group Consolidation to convert the human need for inclusion into the loss of access to a community. In touring, where work, housing, meals, travel and rehiring all run through the same crew network, the group is also the employer's informal gateway. It is hard to detect because no single act is a decision, because exclusion is framed as neutral "picking sides," and because the reporter's own private words can be repurposed to make the removal look earned. Whether anyone organized it would require additional evidence. What can be lost is access to the world the person worked and lived in.

combos.name: Divide and Conquer
combos.definition: Divide and Conquer is the sequence where natural allies are kept apart by a party that controls the information flowing between them, using Triangulation, Smear Campaigns, Information Control, Splitting, Priming, Comparative Devaluation, and Selective Information Sharing to convert each group's trust that the other sees the same full picture into the loss of any shared, complete view of the situation. In performing arts organizations, where players, crew, staff and management are tightly interdependent but organized in separate groups with separate channels, this is especially easy to achieve, since each group's ordinary habits supply half the work. It is hard to detect because every document is individually accurate, because each group's suspicion of the other feels like its own conclusion, and because the person who could compare both views is often an intermediary asked to deliver rather than explain. Whether the design was deliberate would require additional evidence. What can be lost is leverage, solidarity and the chance to bargain from a shared set of facts.

combos.name: Manufactured Consensus
combos.definition: Manufactured Consensus is the sequence where an appearance of broad agreement is assembled through coordinated amplification, so that real people take the appearance for the underlying reality, using False Consensus, Social Proof Pressure, Information Cascades, Sock Puppets, Coordinated Reporting, Priming, and Reputation Laundering to convert deference to apparent group agreement into the loss of accurate information about how much support a song, an artist or a position actually has. In the music business, where charts, streams, playlist adds and "buzz" function as proof of value, the signal that decides careers is also the signal that can be shaped. The pattern is hard to detect because the resulting numbers are real as numbers, because ordinary promotion looks similar, and because the artist, the audience and the market each take the output as independent evidence. Intent would require additional evidence. What can be lost is an honest read on one's own career.

combos.name: Mobbing
combos.definition: Mobbing is the sequence where a person is targeted by many contributors whose individual actions each seem minor, using Pile-Ons, Ostracism, Silent Coalitions, Smear Campaigns, Group Consolidation, Scapegoating, and Coordinated Reporting to convert the need for safety in numbers and the fear of standing alone into the loss of individual judgment and of safety from coordinated group pressure. In rehearsal, touring and production settings, where a leader works in close quarters with dozens of people under time pressure, discomfort is common and grievances are real, which makes the pattern hard to separate from legitimate concern. It is hard to detect because each complaint may be sincere, because the cumulative effect is greater than any single piece, and because institutions can use the volume as evidence of fault. Whether the activity was coordinated would require additional evidence. What can be lost is professional standing, a sense of fair process, and the ability to think clearly under pressure.

combos.name: The Smear-and-Replace
combos.definition: The Smear-and-Replace is the sequence where a departing person's reputation is damaged among the gatekeepers who control future access, while a replacement receives the identical elevated treatment, using Smear Campaigns, Reputation Warfare, Idealize-Devalue-Discard, Love Bombing (Redirected), The Exception Script (Recycled), and Comparative Devaluation to convert a person's belief that public reputation reflects private reality into the loss of the distinction between a manufactured and an earned reputation. In group-based acts, where members are interchangeable in marketing and the brand belongs to the project more than the person, the substitution can be staged cleanly. It is hard to detect because the replacement's success is later cited as proof that the departed person was the problem, because each stage can be explained as ordinary management, and because the same language is delivered so sincerely that it is hard to see as a script. Whether this was a deliberate method would require additional evidence. What can be lost is the accuracy of a career story.

combos.name: The Data Weaponization System
