combos.definition: The Data Weaponization System is the sequence in which a number is stripped of its surrounding facts, turned into a color or an arrow, set against a chosen set of peers, and then used to decide who receives support, so that the resulting label becomes the artist's identity and the artist starts reshaping the work to chase the metric, using decontextualized measurement, visual simplification and comparison architecture to convert trust in a score into the loss of fair, context-aware evaluation. It can function as a way for a label, distributor, management team or platform tool to look neutral while making a resource decision, and the people who benefit may be anyone who needs a defensible reason that does not require explaining the real one. It exploits a reasonable belief that data is objective. It is hard to detect because every individual figure may be accurate; the distortion lives in what is left out, what it is compared to, and what is done with it. The artist may lose promotional support, creative range, time, and the chance to be judged on the whole picture. Intent would require additional evidence, since a team can build exactly this structure by accident.

combos.name: The Hierarchy Enforcement Engine
combos.definition: The Hierarchy Enforcement Engine is the sequence in which formal reporting lines and access rules are used to keep information moving upward slowly, keep decision-makers out of reach, and teach people that staying in their lane is the professional thing to do, using communication chain restriction, gatekeeping and challenge suppression to convert deference to chain of command into the loss of direct access to decision-makers when it matters. It can function as ordinary organization or as a filter that dilutes urgency at each layer. Everyone in the chain may benefit from a quiet tour, and the structure may operate with nobody intending it. It is hard to detect because every handoff looks polite and procedural. The person may lose the chance to be heard when time matters, and may lose confidence that their concern is theirs to raise. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Resource Extraction Pipeline
combos.definition: The Resource Extraction Pipeline is the sequence in which an organization is structured so that its mission cannot be funded as designed, the shortfall is quietly filled by the personal money and unpaid labor of the people who care most, and the filling is then praised as dedication, using structural underfunding, gap normalization and personal subsidy extraction to convert professional dedication into personal money, time and energy that should not have been required. It can function without any single person intending it, because each step feels like generosity. The organization benefits from a mission delivered at a cost it does not carry. It is hard to detect because the person giving is proud to give and the people receiving are sincerely grateful. The person may lose savings, free time and a sense that their work is worth being paid for. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Coercive Control
combos.definition: Coercive Control is the sequence in which one person, who holds both an intimate and a professional position over another, regulates daily life, information, money, relationships, location, devices, emotions, energy and intimacy until refusing costs more than complying, using behavior control, information control and financial control to convert the artist's need for autonomy across every domain of daily life into the comprehensive loss of autonomy, safety and often physical wellbeing. It can function inside a management agreement that hides the household, and the household that hides the agreement. The person who benefits may control the artist's career and the artist's life. It is hard to detect because each act can be explained as care, strategy or love, and because the person inside it may be proud of the partnership. Intent would require additional evidence, and this script does not diagnose anyone.

combos.name: Bureaucratic Violence
combos.definition: Bureaucratic Violence is the sequence in which institutional process is turned into a weapon, with draining requirements that multiply without resolution, paperwork demands that consume all capacity, escalation that professionalizes a dispute, implied consequences that keep pressure on, privacy rules that block transparency, vague conclusions that cannot be contested and documents that serve the institution's story, using process exhaustion and paper terrorism to convert reliance on institutional process into the loss of time, resources and standing. It can function without any single person intending harm, because each step looks like compliance. The institution may benefit from a quiet exit or a compliant partner. It is hard to detect because every request has a plausible reason. The person may lose bookings, savings, relationships and reputation. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Professional Destruction
combos.definition: The Professional Destruction sequence is the pattern in which a person's standing in their field is dismantled step by step through institutional channels, using Credit Theft, Scapegoating, Smear Campaigns, Managed Out Through Exhaustion, PIP Weaponization, Reputation Warfare, Administrative Escalation and Labeling as Identity Warfare to convert reliance on professional reputation into the loss of a career built on that reputation. It can function as a series of ordinary workplace acts, each defensible alone, that together move credit away from the target, attach blame to them, and then convert a manufactured record into formal process. It is hard to detect because every step uses legitimate documents and routine language, and because in a small, relationship-driven industry a quiet reputation shift travels faster than any formal complaint. Intent would require additional evidence, and the pattern can also emerge from structure alone.

combos.name: Knowledge Weaponization
combos.definition: The Knowledge Weaponization sequence is the pattern in which expertise and credentials are deployed to dominate rather than illuminate, using Information Control, False Authority, Credential-Costuming, Gaslighting by Omission, Strategic Incompleteness, Authority Hijack and Sealioning to convert deference to credentialed expertise into the loss of the ability to evaluate a claim on its own merits. It can function as a closed circuit in which the person who holds the information, the title and the paperwork also decides what the client is allowed to understand. It benefits whoever profits from the client's inability to check. It is hard to detect because genuine expertise looks very similar, and because a client who feels unqualified to question tends to blame themselves. In the music business, where royalty flows, publishing structures and contract language are genuinely complex, the cost can be years of unexamined income. Intent would require additional evidence, and the same pattern can arise from habit or from a professional's real discomfort with a client's scrutiny.

combos.name: The Total Institution
combos.definition: The Total Institution is the sequence where one system manages almost every part of a person's daily life, using Behavior Control, Information Control, Thought Control, Emotion Control, Ritualized Exhaustion, "We're Family" Erasure, Financial Dependence by Design, Isolation, Phobia Indoctrination, Demonstrating Omnipotence and Enforcing Trivial Demands to convert dependence on the institution into the loss of life domains that exist independent of it. It can function as a closed environment in which the program is simultaneously employer, school, home, lender, family and judge. It benefits the organization that gains reliable output and low exit. It is hard to detect from outside because each rule has a stated development purpose, and from inside because the person has no unmanaged vantage point from which to compare. Intense, structured training exists in many arts, and the pattern is a matter of degree and combination, not of discipline alone. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Systemic Entrapment
combos.definition: The Systemic Entrapment sequence is the pattern in which every route out of an arrangement is made costly, unclear or frightening, using Financial Dependence by Design, Isolation, Information Control, Legal/Administrative Threats, Phobia Indoctrination, Golden Bars, Process Exhaustion and Diffusion of Responsibility to convert trust that formal systems provide a way out into the loss of a genuine, usable path to a different outcome. It can function as a structure with no single wall: each element is defensible alone, and together they leave no practical exit. It benefits whoever collects revenue from the artist's continued stay. It is hard to detect because there is often no individual to point to, and because the comfort in the arrangement is real. Intent would require additional evidence, and a complicated exit can also be the result of ordinary contract design, unreviewed legacy terms or a poorly resourced support desk.

combos.name: The Paper Trail Ambush
combos.definition: The Paper Trail Ambush is the sequence where a record is assembled in advance to support a conclusion already reached, using Paper-Trail Traps, False Reports, Complaint Weaponization, Preemptive Accusation, Priming, Selective Memory and Vague Allegations to convert trust that documentation exists to protect into the loss of confidence that a paper trail reflects reality. It can function as a file that the target never sees until the meeting at which it is used. It benefits whoever wants a decision to look justified and procedural. It is hard to detect because each document looks like ordinary record-keeping, and because the target is first shown the file when they have the least ability to answer it. Intent would require additional evidence, and a late or poorly shared concern file can also be the result of conflict avoidance, inexperience or an owner who is genuinely worried.

combos.name: Helicopter Surveillance
combos.definition: Helicopter Surveillance is the sequence where constant monitoring is demonstrated through casual references to a person's movements and responses, using Location Tracking, Stalking-by-Notification, Response-Time Policing, Device Access Demands and Demonstrating Omnipotence to convert a caregiver's or partner's desire to ensure safety into the loss of independent movement and unmonitored decision-making. It can function as a protective measure or as a control pattern, and the difference often shows only in how it expands over time. It is difficult to detect because no command is ever issued: the person learns the boundaries by noticing what is quietly known. Over time the target may lose privacy, spontaneity and the habit of making choices that need no explanation. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern can also come from genuine anxiety.

combos.name: Digital Identity Destruction
combos.definition: Digital Identity Destruction is the sequence where a person's online existence is replaced with a fabricated version of themselves, using Doxxing, Deepfake Video/Audio, AI Voice Cloning, Forged Screenshots, Account Takeover, Intimate Image Abuse, Reputation Laundering, Context Collapse and Sock Puppets to convert reliance on a stable, verifiable online identity into the loss of control over one's own digital reputation and identity. It is especially potent for artists and voice performers, whose voice, face and name are the product. It is hard to detect because each artifact can look plausible, support channels are fragmented, and authenticity is expensive to prove. What can be lost is bookings, accounts, income, relationships, and a sense of safety. Who is behind such an attack is often unknown, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: Online Reputation Annihilation
combos.definition: Online Reputation Annihilation is the sequence where a coordinated, multi-platform attack replaces a person's public record with a fabricated or distorted one, using Smear Campaigns, Sock Puppets, Coordinated Reporting, Context Collapse, Doxxing, Reputation Laundering, Pile-Ons, Information Cascades and Brigading to convert reliance on online reputation as a real-world asset into the loss of control over one's own name and public narrative. In music and entertainment it can land on critics, performers, publicists, creators and anyone whose bookings depend on search results and press access. It is difficult to detect because genuine fan anger, ordinary criticism and coordinated activity look alike at the surface, and platform systems often cannot tell them apart. What can be lost is income, access, accounts and a sense of safety. Whether an attack is coordinated is a question of evidence, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Algorithmic Sorting Machine
combos.definition: The Algorithmic Sorting Machine is the sequence where a platform's historical data about an artist is used to predict who will like their work and then to deliver the work only to those people, so that the prediction creates the evidence that confirms it, using Data Point Extraction, Algorithmic Profiling, Intervention Channeling, Confirmation Feedback Loop, Track Solidification and Demographic Patterning to convert an artist's trust that recommendation systems assess potential rather than lock it in into the loss of an open, undetermined future trajectory. It exploits the fact that streaming, playlisting and promotion tools sort music and audiences by past behavior. It is hard to detect because each step looks like neutral personalization, and because the system's inner workings are rarely visible to artists. What can be lost is the ability to reinvent, to be heard by new listeners, and the career that depends on that. How these systems operate in detail needs verification. [VERIFIED SOURCE NEEDED]

combos.name: The Gamification Trap
combos.definition: The Gamification Trap is the sequence where game mechanics manufacture engagement that looks like devotion and works as behavioral conditioning, using Variable Reward Scheduling, Streak Architecture, Progress Gamification, Intrinsic Motivation Displacement, Engagement-Learning Conflation and A/B Tested Behavioral Engineering to convert a young fan's attraction to reward and progress into time, attention and unpaid labor, and to wear down the original love of the music. In the entertainment sector it appears in fan apps, community platforms and artist-run reward systems, where posting, moderating and watching are counted as loyalty. It is difficult to detect because the activity is chosen, social and warm, and because the mechanics are tuned out of sight. What can be lost is sleep, attention, schoolwork, the pleasure of the music itself, and, for some, money. Whether any given app was designed to maximize time is a matter of evidence, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Platform Lock-In
combos.definition: The Platform Lock-In is the sequence where a free or low-cost tool becomes the infrastructure of an artist's career, so that data, workflow and audience relationships accumulate on one vendor's servers until leaving becomes prohibitively costly, using Free Adoption, Ecosystem Embedding, Data Accumulation, Switching Cost Inflation, Terms Modification and Institutional Dependency Normalization to convert an attraction to free or low-cost tools into the loss of leverage and the practical option to switch systems later. It concentrates in distributors, aggregators, link tools, playlist pitch tools, fan-data platforms and artist services, where independent artists have no one else to build their operations with. It is difficult to detect because every step is useful and the cost appears late. What can be lost is bargaining power, history, income and choice. Whether any provider designs lock-in deliberately would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Comparison Engine
combos.definition: The Comparison Engine is the sequence where every performance is converted into a relative position, so that achievement is never experienced as sufficient, using Positional Scoring, Real-Time Visibility, Averages as Benchmarks, Parental Amplification, Intrinsic-Extrinsic Displacement and Permanent Insufficiency Installation to turn the ordinary need for a sense of adequate accomplishment into the lasting loss of the ability to feel that enough has been done. In the entertainment and music industry it can concentrate in talent competitions, chart and stream dashboards, label scorecards and any live ranking that treats a person's work as a position rather than a piece of work. It may benefit whoever profits from engagement, ratings, retention or the artist's continued striving. It is hard to detect because the numbers are public, often accurate, and presented as transparency. What the person can lose is the ability to hear their own work, and to ever feel finished.

combos.name: Psychological Identity Theft
combos.definition: Psychological Identity Theft is the sequence where a person's self-concept is first fused to another party's flattering view of them, then gradually dissolved, then replaced with installed labels and judgments until the replacement feels as though it was always theirs, using Identity Hooking, Identity Erosion, Labeling as Identity Warfare, Shame Installation, Dehumanization and Internalized Conditioning to convert the need for a stable, self-defined identity into the loss of one's original sense of self. In the entertainment and music industry it can concentrate in artist development, persona and brand briefs, styling, image provisions and "positioning" work around a newly signed artist. It may benefit whoever owns the output and the brand. It is hard to detect because each change is small, framed as growth and often accompanied by real expertise. What can be lost is the ability to recognize oneself in one's own work.

combos.name: Competence Undermining
combos.definition: Competence Undermining is the sequence where a person's belief in their own ability is steadily eroded so that they come to doubt that they can function without the system that diminishes them, using Credit Theft, Infantilization, Negging, Weaponized Incompetence, Sabotaging Success, Impossible Metrics and Comparative Devaluation to convert the desire to be seen as capable into the loss of credit for one's own work and demonstrated ability. In the entertainment and music industry it can concentrate in studios, producer-assistant relationships, writing rooms, label departments and any hierarchy where credits, session notes and recommendation matter more than the work itself. It may benefit the person who takes the credit and the structure that relies on unrecognized labor. It is hard to detect because each act is small, warm and plausible, and because the credit is often fixed in documents the junior person is asked to proofread. What can be lost is credit, confidence and a career built on both.

combos.name: Manufactured Crisis Bonding
combos.definition: Manufactured Crisis Bonding is the sequence where an emergency is created or inflated specifically so that shared intensity, rather than trust, forms the attachment, using Strategic Chaos/Crisis Manufacturing, Forced Teaming, Trauma Bonding, Emotional Flooding and Isolation to turn the need for connection under shared threat into the loss of accurate judgment about who is trustworthy. In the entertainment and music industry it can concentrate in festival production, touring crews, release campaigns and any environment where real emergencies are routine and the line between genuine and invented urgency is hard to see. It may benefit the person who gains a devoted, uncritical helper. It is hard to detect because real emergencies are common, the emotion is real, and the person who created the crisis is often the one comforting you. What can be lost is the ability to judge who deserves trust.

combos.name: The Identity Replacement Program
combos.definition: The Identity Replacement Program is the sequence where belonging is offered first and the self is renegotiated afterward, using Love Bombing, Identity Hooking, Isolation, Thought Control, Loaded Language, Phobia Indoctrination, Shame Installation, Conditional Love, Identity Erosion and Internalized Conditioning to convert an artist's need for belonging and a coherent creative identity into the loss of the self that existed before the relationship. In music it can concentrate in live-in collectives, imprint "families" and writing houses, because creative identity is unstable there and the people who offer a home often control the studio, the credits and the money. It is hard to detect because every step can be explained as culture or care, and the target often experiences the result as personal growth. What can be lost is the earlier self-concept, outside relationships, creative ownership, and the ability to tell the house's view from one's own. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern can arise from sincere communities as well as from deliberate design.

combos.name: The Scapegoat Machine
combos.definition: The Scapegoat Machine is the sequence where a group under strain moves its shared problem onto one person, using Scapegoating, Labeling as Identity Warfare, Group Consolidation, Pile-Ons, Smear Campaigns, Ostracism, Shame Installation and Internalized Conditioning to convert the target's need for belonging into the loss of their standing and a fair account of what happened. In touring and studio life it concentrates around post-tour debriefs, shortfalls, cancelled dates and failed releases, because losses are large, causes are tangled, and the crew is small, interdependent and reputation-driven. It is hard to detect because each person's contribution looks minor and well-meant, and because real mistakes are often mixed in with systemic ones. What can be lost is standing in the band or crew, future bookings, and the target's own confidence in what really happened. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern can arise from panic as readily as from design.

combos.name: Weaponized Therapy Language
combos.definition: Weaponized Therapy Language is the sequence where the vocabulary of care is used to reframe resistance as a symptom, using Therapeutic Manipulation/Pathological Framing, Labeling as Identity Warfare, Trash-Can Diagnosis, Concern Trolling, Shame Installation, Tone Policing and Forced Forgiveness to convert an artist's trust in therapeutic support into the loss of the ability to tell genuine support from control dressed as care. In the music industry it concentrates where wellness programs, coaches or counselors are arranged or paid for by a label, manager or tour, and where notes, summaries or "care coordination" reach the same people who negotiate the artist's contracts. It is hard to detect because the people involved may be sincere, the language is genuinely helpful in other settings, and the artist often wants help. What can be lost is the artist's confidence in their own anger, their bargaining position, and the line between treatment and management. Intent would require additional evidence; the pattern can arise from good-faith but poorly designed arrangements.

combos.name: The Student Athlete Extraction
combos.definition: The Student Athlete Extraction is the sequence where a young person's exceptional ability is identified, absorbed into an institution that earns from it, and treated as the primary product while schooling, health and future options are quietly rearranged around it, using Talent Identification and Institutional Capture, Academic Subordination, Labor Extraction, Identity Narrowing, Body Commodification and Disposability Architecture to convert a child's talent and hope for opportunity into revenue and visibility for others. In music the "athlete" is the prodigy performer, and the pattern concentrates in competition circuits, talent programs and parent-and-manager arrangements around child instrumentalists, singers and dancers. It is hard to detect because each step arrives as opportunity, the child often loves the music, and the costs are deferred. What can be lost is academic development, a fallback plan and long-term physical health. Deliberate design would require additional evidence; the pattern can emerge from ordinary incentives.

combos.name: The Parent Silencer
combos.definition: The Parent Silencer is the sequence where an institution assumes a parent's engagement while creating conditions that make engagement feel dangerous for a vulnerable parent, using ID Gatekeeping, Form Intimidation, Language Barriers as Isolation, Confidentiality Uncertainty, the Engagement-Exposure Equation and Children as Collateral Consequence to convert a parent's need to be involved in a child's institutional life into withdrawal, and then to record that withdrawal as disinterest. In the music sector it concentrates around child performers in studios, programs, auditions and labels, where parents sign guardian consents, image releases and payroll forms. It is hard to detect because each requirement sounds routine and the institution may genuinely not intend the fear it produces. What can be lost is safe parental engagement without exposure to unrelated risk, and the child's strongest advocate. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Gifted Child Weaponization
combos.definition: The Gifted Child Weaponization is the sequence where a child's ability is named, the name becomes an identity, the identity carries obligations, and the child learns that struggle is evidence of failure, using Identification as Identity Assignment, Expectation Inflation, Struggle Prohibition, Perfectionism Installation, Risk Aversion and Joy Extinction to convert a child's gift into a performance standard owned by others. In music it concentrates around choir schools, conservatory pipelines, competition circuits and label development programs, where "gifted" is both a compliment and a commercial category. It is hard to detect because the praise is sincere and the child often appears to be thriving. What can be lost is the freedom to struggle, fail or take risks without shame. Whether any adult intends this would require additional evidence; the pattern can emerge from affection and ambition alike.

combos.name: The Exception Script
combos.definition: The Exception Script is the sequence where a person is convinced they are uniquely valued and therefore exempt from the pattern that applies to everyone else, using Love Bombing, Exclusive Meaning, Manufactured Destiny, Future Faking, Conditional Love and Comparative Devaluation to convert a hope to be recognized into a belief that ordinary caution does not apply. In music it concentrates around first approaches to emerging artists, social-media discoveries, studio invitations and early development agreements. It is hard to detect because real enthusiasm, real research and real opportunity can look identical in the early weeks, and because the exceptional status feels like evidence rather than a tactic. What can be lost is ordinary caution that "exceptional" status was used to bypass, along with ownership, time and money. Whether the person intends this would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Competitive Isolation Grid
combos.definition: The Competitive Isolation Grid is the sequence where potential allies become competitors because every relationship runs through one central controller, using Triangulation, Comparative Devaluation, Manufactured Scarcity, Information Control, Isolation and Conditional Love to convert a person's need for peer connection into dependence on whoever benefits from the disconnection. In music it concentrates around managers, imprints and rosters with a shared pool of attention, singles, sessions and slots. It is hard to detect because scarcity is often real, confidentiality is often legitimate, and each interaction on its own can sound caring. What can be lost is solidarity and direct, uncontrolled relationships with peers. Intent would require additional evidence; some of this can emerge from an overloaded, disorganized or genuinely resource-limited roster.

combos.name: The Performative Ally
combos.definition: The Performative Ally is the sequence where a person or organization publicly positions itself as a champion of a cause while the private reality does not match, using Virtue Signaling as Shield, Performative Public Affection, Reputation Laundering, Concern Trolling, Tokenism, Pseudo-Consultation and Strategic Philanthropy to convert trust in a public ally into protection for conduct that would otherwise be questioned. In music it concentrates around festivals, labels, brands and prominent artists that advertise inclusion, charity or equity while the people they feature are unpaid, advisory or symbolic. It is hard to detect because the commitment may be partly sincere, public statements are not false in themselves, and challenging an ally feels like attacking the person who "gets it." What can be lost is the protection an ally's public reputation was supposed to provide, along with fees, credit and standing. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Double Life Manager
combos.definition: The Double Life Manager is the sequence where a person in a position of professional power maintains two sharply different presentations of themselves, a warm and generous public one and a cold, controlling private one, and keeps them apart so that nobody can easily compare them, using Dr. Jekyll/Mr. Hyde, Compartmentalization, Plausible Deniability, Performative Public Affection, Gaslighting, and Information Control to convert the trust that others place in a visible reputation into the isolation and self-doubt of the one person who sees both. It exploits the reasonable assumption that the version of someone you see most is the whole of them. It is hard to detect because the public warmth is often partly real, the private conduct is deniable, and each audience holds only half the picture. What the target can lose is a consistent, verifiable understanding of who someone actually is, and with it confidence in their own perception and, in a small industry, standing and the next job. Intent would require additional evidence, and a person can be inconsistent without designing it.

combos.name: The Benevolent Dictator
combos.definition: The Benevolent Dictator is the sequence where a person with total authority over an ensemble, label, or roster exercises control through warmth, paternalism, and apparent inclusion, using Velvet Glove Control, Performative Public Affection, "I Know Best" Paternalism, Conditional Love, Infantilization, Demonstrating Omnipotence, and Pseudo-Consultation to convert the need for care and guidance into the loss of autonomy over one's own decisions. It can be hard to detect because the warmth is frequently genuine, the person may sincerely believe they know best, and every override is delivered as protection. It tends to benefit whoever holds the podium, while the cost to others is a slow erosion of voice that feels ungrateful to name. Intent would require additional evidence, and sincere care can coexist with the pattern.

combos.name: The Gauntlet
combos.definition: The Gauntlet is the sequence where leaving is made more painful than staying, using Extinction Bursts, Hoovering, Smear Campaigns, Stalking-by-Notification, Flying Monkeys, Punishment by Proxy, Legal/Administrative Threats and Emotional Blackmail to convert a person's desire for a clean, low-conflict departure into a loss of safety and peace. It benefits whoever wants the other person to remain, or to leave with nothing. It is hard to detect because each piece resembles something ordinary: grief, concern from friends, a solicitor's letter, a shared calendar. What can be lost is safety, income, reputation and the ability to walk away.

combos.name: The Cult of Personality
combos.definition: The Cult of Personality is the sequence where an organization or inner circle is organized around devotion to one charismatic figure, using Charismatic Authority, Love Bombing, Identity Hooking, Manufactured Destiny, "We're Family" Erasure, Thought-Stopping Clichés, Phobia Indoctrination, Demonstrating Omnipotence, and Conditional Love to convert the need for meaning, belonging, and purpose into the loss of independent judgment about the leader and the ability to leave without stigma. It is hard to detect because the purpose can be real, the warmth is often sincere, and the most visible parts of it are celebrated. In entertainment, it can concentrate where a star's home, studio, and household overlap with the workplace. Naming a pattern is not a verdict on anyone's character, and intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Recursive Trap
combos.definition: The Recursive Trap is the sequence where every attempt to resolve, name, or escape a problem inside a stated process is absorbed back into the problem, using Double Binds, Complaint Weaponization, Role Reversal Traps, Meta-Gaslighting, Semantic Traps, and Kafka Trapping to convert a person's good-faith willingness to use the process into the loss of any path of response that does not worsen the situation. It is hard to detect because each step looks procedural: a portal, a policy, a meeting, a courteous reply. It can resemble ordinary bureaucracy, and most bureaucratic friction is not this. What distinguishes the pattern is that the act of raising the problem becomes evidence against the person raising it. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Weaponized Gift Economy
combos.definition: The Weaponized Gift Economy is the sequence where generosity is used to build a hidden ledger of obligation, using Loan-Sharking Gifts, Weaponized Generosity in Public, Strategic Philanthropy, Demand for Gratitude, Obligation Hooks, Guilt-Tripping, and Financial Enmeshment to convert the natural norm of reciprocating gifts into the loss of financial clarity, including the ability to tell a gift from a loan. It is hard to detect because generosity is celebrated, the paperwork often arrives later, and the recipient's gratitude is sincere. In music, it can be especially opaque because advances, recoupment, and gifts may sit in the same ledger. Intent would require additional evidence, and genuine generosity exists.

combos.name: The Wellness Trap
combos.definition: The Wellness Trap is the sequence where the conditions that strain a person are left in place while wellness tools are offered to help them endure it, using Therapeutic Manipulation/Pathological Framing, Strategic Chaos (Maintained), Shame Installation, Pseudo-Consultation, Concern Trolling, and Individualization of Systemic Issues to convert the desire for wellbeing and to be seen as coping into the loss of the recognition that distress can have a structural, not personal, cause. It is hard to detect because care is often sincerely offered, wellness resources can help, and the structure is rarely named. In music, it can concentrate around touring, release cycles, and recovery. Intent would require additional evidence, and this script makes no clinical claims about any person or program.

combos.name: Surveillance Architecture
combos.definition: Surveillance Architecture is the sequence where private speech is captured under a vague disclosure, mined for vulnerabilities and leverage, passed on to people the speaker never named, and then hinted at through an exact quotation, so the speaker learns that candor was kept but not how far it went. It uses Buried Consent Disclosure, Covert Recording, Data Harvesting, Non-Consensual Distribution, Selective Deployment and Chilling Effect to convert trust in a professional relationship where candor feels private into the loss of the freedom to speak openly. It benefits whoever holds the recordings. It is hard to detect because routine session recording and agreed content capture are ordinary in music, and the consent paragraph, however thin, exists. What can be lost is private speech, and the openness that supports health and creative work.

combos.name: The Phantom Equity
combos.definition: The Phantom Equity is the sequence where a promise of deferred ownership is used to buy discounted design, production or writing work, using Alignment Framing, Paper Deferral, Complexity Shield, Milestone Migration, Dilution Disguise and Exit Forfeiture to convert a creative worker's belief in a future stake into below-market labor and an unpapered claim. It benefits whoever receives the work without carrying an enforceable obligation. It is hard to detect because every step has an ordinary explanation: rounds slip, lawyers are expensive, equity is technical. The worker may lose the gap between market price and pay, and a stake that may never have existed on paper. Intent would require additional evidence, since many early promises are sincere and simply never formalized.

combos.name: The Allocation Scarcity Engine
combos.definition: The Allocation Scarcity Engine is the sequence where a person is told they are receiving rare access to something others are competing for, backed by demand and an anchor party that cannot be checked and a deadline inside the time verification would take, using Privileged Access Framing, Manufactured Oversubscription, Compressed Window, Phantom Lead, Commitment Before Verification, and FOMO Lock to convert fear of missing out and deference to apparent social proof into payment before checking is possible. It can benefit whoever collects the fee, and it is hard to detect because every ingredient also exists in honest programs: real slots are limited, real windows close, and real A&R people do attend. What the target may lose is the time and standing needed to verify before committing, and then the willingness to ask questions at all, because having paid can make the questions feel embarrassing.

combos.name: The Economics Obfuscation Layer
combos.definition: The Economics Obfuscation Layer is the sequence where the true cost and payout terms of an arrangement are spread across several entities, documents and fee categories so that no single page shows the whole picture, using Structural Layering, Fee Diffusion, Standard-Term Camouflage, Waterfall Opacity, Complexity-as-Authority and Disaggregated Consent to convert trust in headline terms and discomfort with admitting confusion into lost visibility over the total cost. It benefits whoever sits at several points of the money flow. It is hard to detect because every document can be accurate, signed on a different day, and described as routine. What the artist may lose is knowledge of what the whole arrangement costs, and the ability to compare it with alternatives. Intent would require additional evidence, since complex royalty structures often arise from legitimate history.

combos.name: The Reputation Hostage
combos.definition: The Reputation Hostage is the sequence where a public endorsement is secured early, before any concern exists, so that the endorser's standing becomes tied to the endorsed party's, using Public Association, Reputation Braiding, Mutual Exposure Framing, Silence Incentivization, Complicity Implication and Successor Enablement to convert concern for one's own public standing into silence about later conduct. It benefits the party whose conduct benefits from a credible voice that stays quiet. It is hard to detect because no threat is needed: self-protection does the work. The endorser may lose the freedom to speak, and others may lose a warning. Intent would require additional evidence, since early endorsements are often sincere and later problems often unplanned.

combos.name: The Mirror Hook
combos.definition: The Mirror Hook is the sequence where a persona that appears to fit the target arrives, matches their pace and then sets it, offers curated disclosures that invite theirs, and asks for exclusivity before the target could know who they are, using Catfishing, Pacing and Leading, Premature Vulnerability / Trauma Dumping, Premature Trust Extraction, Premature Exclusivity and Identity Hooking to convert the wish to be understood quickly into lost time to verify. It benefits whoever holds the persona. It is hard to detect because each step feels like being finally seen. The artist may lose unreleased work, contacts, access and the chance to check who someone is. Intent would require additional evidence, since genuine enthusiasts and scouts also write warmly at night.

combos.name: The Long Con
combos.definition: The Long Con is the sequence where a person's circle and habits are learned, a warm and credible contact (sometimes partly automated) builds trust over weeks, the conversation moves somewhere private, and a money request arrives with a deadline, using Social Mapping, Social Engineering, Manufactured Intimacy, Platform Migration, Pig Butchering (Long-Con Digital Fraud) and Manufactured Urgency to convert loneliness and trust in friendly contact into lost money, accounts and trust in later contacts. It benefits whoever operates the persona and the platform. It is hard to detect because the warmth is real in its effect and the dashboard shows early success. The target may lose savings, accounts and confidence in future connections. The industry layer is thin: this is generic online fraud wearing a music-sector costume. Intent would require additional evidence in any one case.

combos.name: The Halo Shield
combos.definition: The Halo Shield is the sequence where a genuinely admired public image absorbs scrutiny, so that when a harm or discrepancy surfaces the goodwill already banked is spent as protection and the cause is moved onto someone with less standing, using Halo Effect Exploitation, Confirmation Bias Exploitation, Performative Allyship / False Solidarity, Moral Licensing / Strategic Philanthropy and Blame-Shifting to convert trust in people who seem good into a credibility advantage over anyone who reports a problem. It benefits whoever holds the halo. It exploits the reasonable habit of letting a person's best-known quality stand in for their whole record. It is hard to detect because the generosity is usually real, the shielding rarely needs a lie, and the person least able to answer is often someone who has already left. What the target may lose is the chance to be believed, which in an industry run on reputation and rehiring can end a career. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Bench
combos.definition: The Bench is the sequence where a musician is kept available but never chosen, using Bread-crumbing, Anchoring to Peak Moments, Triangulation, Replacement Display and Orbiting to convert hope that the best moments will return into unpaid availability, lost alternative work and a chapter that is hard to close. It benefits whoever wants flexible cover without the cost of commitment. It exploits the fact that in touring, first call, hold and standby are real arrangements, and that a musician's reputation depends on being easy to reach. It is hard to detect because every single hold is genuinely tentative, every note is warm, and ordinary budget decisions look exactly the same from outside. What can be lost is paid work, income planning, confidence and the ability to treat the relationship as over. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Big Ask
combos.definition: The Big Ask is the sequence where an outsized opening request makes a still-heavy real request look reasonable, using Door-in-the-Face, Anchoring, Commitment Traps / Foot-in-the-Door, Ultimatums and Obligation Enforcement to convert the wish to be fair and reasonable into terms the person would not have chosen on a fresh read. It benefits the side with the contract template and the schedule. It exploits the ordinary human habit of treating a concession as a gift to be matched. It is hard to detect because each step looks like negotiation, and negotiation is normal. What the target can lose is rights, income and, importantly, a clear memory of what was actually agreed. Hard but honest bargaining is common and legitimate; intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Praise Leash
combos.definition: The Praise Leash is the sequence where recognition is given for whatever serves the powerful person, the recipient ends up managing that person's feelings, a staged confidence draws out the recipient's own history, and what was shared becomes leverage, using Grooming Through Praise, Emotional Parasitism, Bait Disclosure, Vulnerability Weaponization and Withholding / Silent Treatment to convert a need for recognition into lost privacy and self-trust. It benefits whoever receives the labor and the loyalty. It exploits the fact that in entertainment, being singled out by a star is one of the most valuable forms of recognition. It is hard to detect because the warmth is often sincere and the closeness is real. What can be lost is privacy, sleep, judgment about what is reasonable, and confidence in one's own read of events. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Mood Weather
combos.definition: The Mood Weather is the sequence where small things bring huge reactions, good moments are spoiled without warning, moods change faster than anyone can track and do not fit what is being said, anger sets the rules, and the people around learn to please in advance, using Rage as Regulation, Emotional Contamination, Emotional Sequencing and Fawning to convert the wish to keep the peace into constant anticipatory adjustment. It benefits whoever sets the weather by reducing challenge and feedback. It exploits the fact that a headliner's mood can affect schedules, income and standing. It is hard to detect because each outburst can be explained by stress, and each warm moment is real. What can be lost is calm, spontaneity, honest feedback and one's emotional baseline. Intent would require additional evidence, and this material describes patterns, not diagnoses of people.

combos.name: The Unwinnable Conversation
combos.definition: The Unwinnable Conversation is the sequence where a discussion is arranged so that no point can be settled, using Pseudo-Logic, Gish Gallop / Firehose of Falsehood, Exaggeration, Gotcha Framing, Tone Policing, Metacommunicative Abuse and Confusion as Control to convert a person's belief that a fair conversation can settle things into a loss of clarity about what they actually think happened. In the music business it surfaces wherever money and credit are discussed live, such as a call with a co-writer, duo partner, manager or business affairs contact, and where the paper (split sheets, registrations, statements) is too dense to verify at speaking speed. It is hard to detect because every sentence can sound reasonable and the person leaves tired and unsure rather than wronged. What can be lost is a correct split, months of income and confidence in one's own records. Intent would require additional evidence; tough negotiation and genuine complexity look similar in the moment.

combos.name: The Perspective Eraser
combos.definition: The Perspective Eraser is the sequence where a person's own account of events is gradually replaced by another party's, using Gaslighting, Perspecticide, Weaponized Therapy-Speak, Tone Policing and Collapse of Narrative Continuity to convert trust in the people who explain you to yourself into the loss of a coherent account of your own life. In the music business it concentrates where partners, managers or labels control the record of what was decided, and where doubts about accounting or a contract can be redescribed as anxiety, sensitivity or unresolved history. It benefits whoever would rather a financial question never be answered. It is hard to detect because the language is caring, the person may genuinely be in distress, and real therapeutic vocabulary is also legitimately used in many healthy teams. What can be lost is a correct reading of the money, a documented account of decisions, and trust in one's own memory. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Wall
combos.definition: The Wall is the sequence where a question or a payment demand meets silence and blank looks until the person gives up, using Stonewalling, Feigned Ignorance, Reverse Psychology, Limited Hangout, Lying and Competitive Victimhood to convert patience and willingness to explain again into the loss of answers, money and the energy to keep asking. In the music business it concentrates around royalty statements, audit requests, settlement sheets and supplier invoices, where responsibility is split across departments, ticketing systems and subcontractors, and where a small supplier or artist depends on the relationship. It benefits whoever would rather not pay or explain. It is hard to detect because each step can look like ordinary administrative friction, and because the final move, a small admission or partial payment, can look like good faith. What can be lost is the amount owed, the right to dispute it, and months of effort. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Positivity Muzzle
combos.definition: The Positivity Muzzle is the sequence where a culture of enforced cheerfulness makes a grievance unsayable, using Toxic Positivity / Weaponized Optimism, Name-Calling Disguised as Humor, Forced Forgiveness / Weaponized Forgiveness and Silence Installation to convert a person's wish to be positive and forgiving into the loss of permission to name harm. In the music business it surfaces in bands, tours, writing camps and crews, where work depends on chemistry, pay is often informal, and being labelled difficult can end a booking. It benefits whoever would rather unpaid money, unsafe conditions or conduct issues stay unspoken. It is hard to detect because good morale is a real and valuable thing, and the people enforcing it may sincerely believe in it. What can be lost is pay owed, a safe working environment and the habit of speaking up. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Information Laundromat
combos.definition: The Information Laundromat is the sequence where a skewed or false claim is placed where people and tools will pick it up, passed along until its origin is lost, and made to look popular, using Context Poisoning, Information Laundering, Astroturfing / Sock Puppets, Computational Propaganda, False Consensus / Social Proof Pressure, Normalization / Overton Window Manipulation and Post-Truth Epistemic Manipulation to convert trust in what seems widely believed into the loss of a shared basis for telling true from false. In the music business it shapes what artists, fans and writers believe about a deal, a rival, a manager or a release, in places like fan encyclopedias, forums, review pages and industry gossip. It is hard to detect because each repetition looks like independent confirmation, and because real industry rumor is common. What can be lost is an accurate understanding of a deal, a reputation, and the ability to check a claim. Intent would require additional evidence.

combos.name: The Coded Crowd
combos.definition: The Coded Crowd is the sequence where a message with a second meaning points an audience at a target, some listeners act while the speaker asks for nothing, outrage skips any check of facts, a crowd arrives, the target's public image is taken over, and the first version of the story is never corrected, using Dog Whistling / Coded Signaling, Stochastic Harassment Direction, Moral Outrage as Weapon, Pile-Ons / Brigading, Reputation Hijacking, and an Uncorrected Record to convert a public voice into lost safety, lost standing, and lost control of one's own story. It benefits whoever wanted the critic quieter, and it benefits them without a single instruction on the record. It exploits visibility itself and the habit of fan communities to defend what they love quickly. It is hard to detect because the originating post can be read as a joke, because fan behavior is often undirected, and because no individual message in the flood is unusual. What the target may lose is personal safety, income from a channel or a career, trust with collaborators, and the ability to say what they actually said. In this sector it matters because careers run on public image, and image travels faster than any correction.

combos.name: The Synthetic Storm
combos.definition: The Synthetic Storm is the sequence where generated versions of a story drown out the original, fabricated media puts words in real mouths, records are altered from the inside, and immersive scenes produce body-level reactions, using Gish Gallop / Firehose of Falsehood, Forged Screenshots / Edited Evidence, Cyber Manipulation Operations (CMOs), and Immersive Manipulation (VR/AR) to convert trust in what people see and hear into confusion about whether any evidence can be believed. It benefits whoever profits when a record cannot be trusted, and it exploits the speed of sharing and the fact that checking is slower than posting. It is hard to detect because each piece looks plausible, because volume exhausts verification, and because real systems do contain real errors. What can be lost is a reputation, a show, a working relationship with an artist, and confidence in any evidence at all. Whether a given clip is synthetic usually needs forensic review, not an impression.

combos.name: The Erased Contributor
combos.definition: The Erased Contributor is the sequence where a person is cut off when they speak, their point is repeated and credited to someone else, their work passes through hands until their name is gone, politeness covers steady punishment, a group turns on them over months, and reviews measure fit instead of work, using Interruption Patterns, Credit Theft, Credit Laundering, "Polite Hostile" Environments, Mobbing, and Performance Framework Manipulation to convert a wish to contribute and be recognized into lost credit, standing, and the record of one's work. It benefits whoever collects the credit and whoever avoids paying for it. It is hard to detect because every step has an ordinary explanation and because no one has to be unkind. In this sector it matters because credit is income: writer shares, society registrations, and future work all follow the name on the sheet.

combos.name: The Body Under Rule
combos.definition: The Body Under Rule is the sequence where every hour is scheduled, rest is cut short, movement needs permission, the body is handled under rules, a few meaningless choices stand in for freedom, and routines leave no energy to resist, using Time Control, Sleep Deprivation, Mobility Control, Body Autonomy Violations, Choice Restriction, and Ritualized Exhaustion to convert dependence on the setting for food, rest or safety into lost physical autonomy and the energy to think. It benefits whoever needs a performer who is available and compliant, and it exploits the real demands of live work. It is hard to detect because tight schedules are normal, safety rules are real, and exhaustion looks like professionalism. In this sector it matters because touring, residencies, and trainee programs bundle housing, work, and rest under the same management.

combos.name: The Room
combos.definition: The Room is the sequence where size, posture and closeness say what words do not, questions arrive like a trial, remarks and nearness create a climate of risk, the threat is never quite spoken, and the person learns to placate to stay safe, using Intimidation, Interrogation, Ambient Sexual Threat, and Fawning to convert physical presence in a shared space into lost safety and a lost ability to say no. It benefits whoever holds power in the room and wants compliance or access without a spoken demand. It is hard to detect because every sentence is deniable and because the target's own appeasing behavior can look like consent. What can be lost is a sense of safety in one's own body, trust in one's own judgment, and professional opportunity. In this sector it matters because the places where careers are made are often closed, late, and private.

combos.name: The Afterlife
combos.definition: The Afterlife is the sequence where separation does not end the hold: after a person leaves a partner, manager or team, they may be monitored, their contact points and accounts may stay in the other side's hands, legal demands may be used to keep them occupied and frightened, control may continue through shared business assets, and the story of the exit may travel ahead of them into new work. It uses Location Tracking, Account Control, Legal Abuse, Post-Separation Abuse and Legacy Contamination to convert the hope that leaving ends the danger into lost safety, privacy, money and a clean start. In music it is hard to detect because ensembles often run on one founder's name, one set of logins and one phone plan, so each piece looks like administration. Intent would require additional evidence, and where safety is in question, specialist support comes before any analysis.

combos.name: The Public Breaking
combos.definition: The Public Breaking is the sequence where degradation is staged as development, a compelled apology or proof of change is demanded in front of others, the group sees what dissent costs, and certain subjects stop being raised. It uses Humiliation Rituals, Overcorrection Demands, Public Exposure, Group Consolidation / Chilling Effect and Silence Installation to convert the wish to belong and improve into lost dignity and voice. In touring companies it is hard to detect because notes sessions, call boards and apologies are routine, nobody has to intend the effect, and the person is often thanked for her attitude. What may be lost is the willingness to say the true thing out loud, which is the most protective habit in a backstage workplace.

combos.name: The Clinical Brush-Off
tactics: Accountability Evasion via Diagnosis / Trash-Can Diagnosis
combos.definition: The Clinical Brush-Off is the sequence where a person's symptoms are treated as fragility, a normal result is used to end the conversation, concern is recast as catastrophizing, a catch-all explanation closes the file, and the person stops asking for help. It uses Minimization, Tone Policing, Accountability Evasion via Diagnosis / Trash-Can Diagnosis and Need Concealment to convert trust in professional care into lost timely treatment and lost trust in one's own body. In performing arts it is hard to detect because performers are used to pain, the clinic is often contracted by the employer, and a normal result feels like good news. This script helps recognize the pattern. It cannot say what any symptom means, and anyone with pain, numbness or loss of function should see a qualified clinician and consider a second opinion.

combos.name: The Captured Referee
combos.definition: The Captured Referee is the sequence where influence is gained over the body meant to oversee a practice, aligned parties are used to enforce its terms, the opposition is quietly guided, an aligned expert closes debate, the resulting policy is cited as proof of good conduct, and the public sees that nothing happens. It uses Institutional Capture, Controlled Opposition, Captive Expertise, Policy as Proof and Visible Impunity to convert the belief that oversight bodies are neutral into the loss of any route to an independent hearing. In music it is hard to detect because panels, charters and reports look like accountability, many members are sincere, and the organizer can point to the paper. It describes a structural pattern, which may arise without anyone planning it.

combos.name: The Crisis Covenant
combos.definition: The Crisis Covenant is the sequence where a crisis, real or inflated, bonds people through shared urgency, "we" language seals an alliance, shared secrets make them complicit, speaking becomes betrayal, and leaving looks impossible. It uses Crisis Bonding, Forced Teaming, Shared Secret Binding, Loyalty Binds and Exit Prevention to convert solidarity in hard times into lost freedom to leave or speak. In independent music it is hard to detect because small labels genuinely run close to the edge, owners are often sincere and sacrificing, and staff do love the work. What can be lost is deferred pay, the ability to raise the matter with others, professional standing and a clean exit. This script cannot say whether any crisis was real, and a hard moment is not proof of wrongdoing.

combos.name: The Body Audit
combos.definition: The Body Audit is the sequence where small remarks about a performer's body, measured against a comparison nobody will show, turn the body into a standing deficiency and a work object, until shame sits where self-regard used to be and the person stops saying what they need. It uses Negging, Comparative Devaluation, Objectification, Shame Installation and Need Concealment to convert the wish to be accepted as you are into lost physical confidence and a reluctance to seek care. It is hard to detect because every remark is small, wardrobe and camera work really do involve measuring bodies, and the harm shows up as private behaviour: skipped meals, hidden symptoms, unmade appointments.

combos.name: The Paper Cage
combos.definition: The Paper Cage is the sequence where a debt for placement, travel or housing grows faster than the work can pay it, identity papers are held "for safekeeping," immigration status is turned into the threat, contact with others is thinned, and leaving comes to look impossible, using Debt Bondage, Document Confiscation, Status Threats, Isolation and Exit Prevention to convert the need for work away from home into lost freedom of movement, legal standing and earnings. It is hard to detect because the work is real, the paperwork is signed, the cabin door opens, and each element has an administrative explanation. Whether any given case amounts to forced labour or trafficking is a legal and factual question for qualified authorities, not for a script.

combos.name: The Soft Sell
combos.definition: The Soft Sell is the sequence where a tiny first ask is made to seem too small to refuse, extras are added before the offer can be weighed, confusing terms are followed by a reassuring frame, a free start quietly continues into a paid plan, prompts return until the person gives in, and what they have already paid keeps them there. It uses Legitimizing Paltry Contributions, That's-Not-All, Disrupt-Then-Reframe, Forced Continuity, Persistent Nagging and Sunk Cost Exploitation to convert the wish to be agreeable and not wasteful into lost money, time and a clear moment of choice. It is hard to detect because every step is small, legal-looking and friendly, and no single screen contains the whole deal. Whether a particular practice is lawful is a jurisdiction-specific question. [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC]

combos.name: The Deniable Accusation
combos.definition: The Deniable Accusation is the sequence where an accusation travels as a question that no one has to own, broad claims retreat to harmless ones whenever they are challenged, the focus shifts to the harmed person's choices, and anyone who keeps speaking faces a legal threat, using Just Asking Questions, Motte-and-Bailey, Victim Blaming and Legal Abuse to convert the belief that fair questions deserve fair answers into lost reputation and a lost public voice. It is hard to detect because questions are legitimate, due process matters, defamation law exists for real reasons, and each move taken alone looks like a reasonable part of a public argument. Whether any statement is defamatory, or any claim abusive, is a legal question that depends on jurisdiction and facts. [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC]

combos.name: The Digital Hostage
combos.definition: The Digital Hostage is the sequence where online closeness is built until an intimate image becomes leverage, private details are exposed or threatened, an emergency response is sent to the person's door, and shame keeps them from asking for help, using Manufactured Intimacy, Sextortion, Doxxing, Swatting and Need Concealment to convert trust in online closeness and fear of exposure into lost safety, privacy and willingness to seek help. It is hard to detect because the closeness is built from genuine attention, the early steps look like fan friendliness or industry networking, and each escalation is designed to make the person feel responsible. It is a crime pattern, and the person targeted is the victim of it, whatever they sent. Legal definitions vary by place. [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC]
